+def parse_dns_from_text(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    values = OrderedDict()
+
+    for match in re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE):
+        values[match.strip()] = None
+
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        if "dns server" not in line.lower() and "dns servers" not in line.lower():
+            continue
+        for candidate in unique_ipv4_values(line):
+            values[candidate] = None
+
+    if not values:
+        for candidate in unique_ipv4_values(text):
+            values[candidate] = None
+
+    return [value for value in values.keys() if not value.startswith("127.")]
+

+"""Send DNS misconfiguration alert email and verify SMTP acceptance."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import smtplib
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime
+from email.message import EmailMessage
+
+
+SMTP_HOST = os.getenv("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.d522.wgu.internal")
+SMTP_PORT = int(os.getenv("SMTP_PORT", "1025"))
+SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 15
+FROM_ADDRESS = os.getenv("DNS_ALERT_FROM", "network-monitoring@localdomain")
+TO_ADDRESS = os.getenv("DNS_ALERT_TO", "stakeholders@localdomain")
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Generate and send DNS configuration alert emails with SMTP verification."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--device-name", required=True, help="Device name for the alert email.")
+    parser.add_argument("--ip-address", required=True, help="Device IP address for the alert email.")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--detected-dns",
+        required=True,
+        help="Detected current DNS setting (for example: 203.0.113.10).",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--expected-dns",
+        default="10.10.10.10, 10.10.10.20",
+        help="Expected DNS setting text (default: 10.10.10.10, 10.10.10.20).",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--timestamp",
+        default="",
+        help="Timestamp text for the email body. If omitted, current time is used.",
+    )
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def build_email(
+    device_name: str,
+    ip_address: str,
+    detected_dns: str,
+    expected_dns: str,
+    timestamp: str,
+) -> EmailMessage:
+    message = EmailMessage()
+    message["Subject"] = f"DNS Configuration Alert: {device_name} ({ip_address})"
+    message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
+    message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
+    message.set_content(
+        "Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"
+        "This is an automated alert that the DNS configuration for the following device has been altered from the expected settings:\n\n"
+        f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+        f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+        f"Detected DNS Setting: {detected_dns}\n"
+        f"Expected DNS Setting: {expected_dns}\n"
+        f"Time Detected: {timestamp}\n\n"
+        "The system will attempt to automatically correct this configuration.\n\n"
+        "Best regards,\n"
+        "Network Monitoring System"
+    )
+    return message
+
+
+def send_email_and_verify(message: EmailMessage) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+    try:
+        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
+            code, banner = server.ehlo()
+            if code >= 400:
+                return False, f"SMTP EHLO failed with code {code} and banner {banner!r}"
+
+            failures = server.send_message(message)
+            if failures:
+                return False, f"SMTP rejected recipient(s): {failures}"
+
+            return True, f"SMTP accepted message via {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT}"
+    except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
+        return False, f"SMTP send failed: {exc}"
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    args = parse_args()
+    timestamp = args.timestamp or datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+
+    email_message = build_email(
+        device_name=args.device_name,
+        ip_address=args.ip_address,
+        detected_dns=args.detected_dns,
+        expected_dns=args.expected_dns,
+        timestamp=timestamp,
+    )
+
+    sent, details = send_email_and_verify(email_message)
+    print(f"Email subject: {email_message['Subject']}")
+    print(f"SMTP verification: {'SUCCESS' if sent else 'FAIL'}")
+    print(f"Details: {details}")
+
+    return 0 if sent else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Fix DNS for failing devices and run break/fix email-ticket workflow."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import ipaddress
+import os
+import re
+import shlex
+import smtplib
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from datetime import datetime
+from email.message import EmailMessage
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import paramiko
+
+
+CSV_FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
+LEGACY_WORKFLOW_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("t2_c4_create_dns_email_break_fix.py")
+CORRECTED_EMAIL_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("t2_c4_4_send_dns_corrected_email.py")
+DNS1 = "10.10.10.10"
+DNS2 = "10.10.10.20"
+APPROVED_DNS = {DNS1, DNS2}
+SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 45
+CONSOLE_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
+CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
+
+DEFAULT_USERNAME = "ubuntu"
+DEFAULT_PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
+
+SMTP_HOST = os.getenv("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.d522.wgu.internal")
+SMTP_PORT = int(os.getenv("SMTP_PORT", "1025"))
+SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+FROM_ADDRESS = os.getenv("DNS_ALERT_FROM", "network-monitoring@localdomain")
+TO_ADDRESS = os.getenv("DNS_ALERT_TO", "stakeholders@localdomain")
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description=(
+            "Fix failing DNS settings for eligible devices, verify results, and run "
+            "the t2_c4_create_dns_email_break_fix.py workflow."
+        )
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--workflow-device-name",
+        default="DB",
+        help="Device name used by t2_c4_create_dns_email_break_fix.py (default: DB).",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--skip-legacy-workflow",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="Only perform fix/verify for failing devices and skip legacy break/fix workflow.",
+    )
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
+    name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
+    return name.startswith("router") or name.startswith("sw") or "switch" in name or name == "smtp"
+
+
+def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    devices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csv_file:
+        for row in csv.DictReader(csv_file):
+            name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+            if should_exclude(name):
+                continue
+
+            inventory_address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+            if not inventory_address or inventory_address.lower() == "none":
+                continue
+
+            devices.append(
+                {
+                    "name": name,
+                    "inventory_address": inventory_address,
+                    "access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
+                    "username": (row.get("Username") or DEFAULT_USERNAME).strip() or DEFAULT_USERNAME,
+                    "password": (row.get("Password") or DEFAULT_PASSWORD).strip() or DEFAULT_PASSWORD,
+                }
+            )
+    return devices
+
+
+def receive_console_output(console: socket.socket, pause_seconds: float = 0.4) -> str:
+    import time
+
+    time.sleep(pause_seconds)
+    chunks: list[bytes] = []
+    while True:
+        try:
+            chunk = console.recv(4096)
+        except socket.timeout:
+            break
+        if not chunk:
+            break
+        chunks.append(chunk)
+    return b"".join(chunks).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+
+
+def unique_ipv4_values(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    values = OrderedDict()
+    for match in re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", text):
+        try:
+            parsed = ipaddress.IPv4Address(match)
+        except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
+            continue
+        values[str(parsed)] = None
+    return list(values)
+
+
+def resolve_dhcp_ip(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    access_port = device.get("access_port", "")
+    if not access_port:
+        return "", "Missing access port for DHCP device"
+
+    try:
+        access_port_number = int(access_port)
+    except ValueError:
+        return "", f"Invalid access port: {access_port}"
+
+    try:
+        with socket.create_connection((CONSOLE_HOST, access_port_number), timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as console:
+            console.settimeout(0.5)
+            receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.2)
+            console.sendall(b"\n")
+            receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.2)
+            console.sendall(f"{DEFAULT_USERNAME}\n".encode())
+            receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.2)
+            console.sendall(f"{DEFAULT_PASSWORD}\n".encode())
+            receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.6)
+            console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
+            output = receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.8)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        return "", str(exc)
+
+    for candidate in unique_ipv4_values(output):
+        if candidate.startswith("127."):
+            continue
+        return candidate, ""
+
+    return "", "No IPv4 address discovered for DHCP device"
+
+
+def connect_ssh(hostname: str, username: str, password: str) -> paramiko.SSHClient:
+    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+    client.connect(
+        hostname=hostname,
+        username=username,
+        password=password,
+        timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+    )
+    return client
+
+
+def parse_dns_from_text(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    values = OrderedDict()
+
+    for match in re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE):
+        values[match.strip()] = None
+
+    if not values:
+        for candidate in unique_ipv4_values(text):
+            values[candidate] = None
+
+    return [value for value in values.keys() if not value.startswith("127.")]
+
+
+def read_dns_settings(hostname: str, username: str, password: str) -> list[str]:
+    client = connect_ssh(hostname, username, password)
+    try:
+        command = "sh -lc 'cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null; echo; resolvectl dns 2>/dev/null; echo; systemd-resolve --status 2>/dev/null'"
+        _, stdout, _ = client.exec_command(command, timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
+        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        return parse_dns_from_text(output)
+    finally:
+        client.close()
+
+
+def canonical_dns(dns_servers: list[str]) -> str:
+    if not dns_servers:
+        return "None"
+    return ", ".join(dns_servers)
+
+
+def evaluate_dns(dns_servers: list[str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    if not dns_servers:
+        return "FAIL", "No DNS servers found"
+
+    unique = set(dns_servers)
+    if not unique.intersection(APPROVED_DNS):
+        return "FAIL", "DNS does not include DNS1 or DNS2"
+
+    unexpected = sorted(server for server in unique if server not in APPROVED_DNS)
+    if unexpected:
+        return "FAIL", f"Unexpected DNS server(s): {', '.join(unexpected)}"
+
+    return "SUCCESS", "DNS points to approved DNS1/DNS2"
+
+
+def send_email(subject: str, body: str) -> bool:
+    message = EmailMessage()
+    message["Subject"] = subject
+    message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
+    message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
+    message.set_content(body)
+
+    try:
+        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
+            server.ehlo()
+            failures = server.send_message(message)
+            return not failures
+    except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException):
+        return False
+
+
+def send_corrected_email(device_name: str, ip_address: str, corrected_dns: str, timestamp: str) -> bool:
+    if not CORRECTED_EMAIL_SCRIPT.exists():
+        print(f"Corrected email script missing: {CORRECTED_EMAIL_SCRIPT}")
+        return False
+
+    command = [
+        sys.executable,
+        str(CORRECTED_EMAIL_SCRIPT),
+        "--device-name",
+        device_name,
+        "--ip-address",
+        ip_address,
+        "--expected-dns",
+        corrected_dns,
+        "--timestamp",
+        timestamp,
+    ]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, check=False, capture_output=True, text=True)
+    if result.stdout.strip():
+        print(result.stdout.strip())
+    if result.stderr.strip():
+        print(result.stderr.strip())
+    return result.returncode == 0
+
+
+def run_remote_sudo(client: paramiko.SSHClient, password: str, command: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
+    stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
+        f"sudo -S -p '' sh -c {shlex.quote(command)}",
+        get_pty=True,
+        timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+    )
+    stdin.write(f"{password}\n")
+    stdin.flush()
+    out = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+    err = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+    exit_code = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
+    out = "\n".join(line for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip() != password).strip()
+    err = "\n".join(line for line in err.splitlines() if line.strip() != password).strip()
+    return exit_code, out, err
+
+
+def remediate_dns(hostname: str, username: str, password: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+    command = (
+        f"printf '%s\\n' 'nameserver {DNS1}' 'nameserver {DNS2}' "
+        "'options timeout:2 attempts:2' > /etc/resolv.conf"
+    )
+    client = connect_ssh(hostname, username, password)
+    try:
+        code, out, err = run_remote_sudo(client, password, command)
+        details = [value for value in (out, err) if value]
+        return code == 0, " | ".join(details) if details else "No command output"
+    finally:
+        client.close()
+
+
+def ensure_hostname_resolution(hostname: str, username: str, password: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+    """Ensure local hostname exists in /etc/hosts to avoid sudo resolution warnings."""
+    client = connect_ssh(hostname, username, password)
+    try:
+        check_command = (
+            "sh -lc 'hn=$(hostname -s 2>/dev/null || hostname); "
+            "if grep -Eq \"(^|[[:space:]])${hn}([[:space:]]|$)\" /etc/hosts; "
+            "then echo OK:${hn}; else echo MISSING:${hn}; fi'"
+        )
+        _, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(check_command, timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
+        check_out = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+        check_err = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+
+        if check_out.startswith("OK:"):
+            return True, f"Hostname mapping present ({check_out[3:]})"
+
+        if not check_out.startswith("MISSING:"):
+            details = check_out or check_err or "Unknown pre-check output"
+            return False, f"Pre-check could not determine hostname mapping: {details}"
+
+        add_command = (
+            "hn=$(hostname -s 2>/dev/null || hostname); "
+            "grep -Eq \"(^|[[:space:]])${hn}([[:space:]]|$)\" /etc/hosts "
+            "|| printf '127.0.1.1 %s\\n' \"${hn}\" >> /etc/hosts"
+        )
+        code, out, err = run_remote_sudo(client, password, add_command)
+        details = [value for value in (out, err) if value]
+        detail_text = " | ".join(details) if details else "No command output"
+        if code != 0:
+            return False, f"Failed to add hostname mapping: {detail_text}"
+
+        return True, f"Added hostname mapping for {check_out[8:]}"
+    finally:
+        client.close()
+
+
+def inspect_device(device: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    runtime_ip = device["inventory_address"]
+    if runtime_ip.lower() == "dhcp":
+        runtime_ip, error = resolve_dhcp_ip(device)
+        if not runtime_ip:
+            return {
+                "name": device["name"],
+                "ip_address": "DHCP",
+                "status": "FAIL",
+                "dns": "Unknown",
+                "reason": error,
+            }
+
+    try:
+        dns_servers = read_dns_settings(runtime_ip, device["username"], device["password"])
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return {
+            "name": device["name"],
+            "ip_address": runtime_ip,
+            "status": "FAIL",
+            "dns": "Unknown",
+            "reason": f"DNS read failed: {exc}",
+        }
+
+    status, reason = evaluate_dns(dns_servers)
+    return {
+        "name": device["name"],
+        "ip_address": runtime_ip,
+        "status": status,
+        "dns": canonical_dns(dns_servers),
+        "reason": reason,
+    }
+
+
+def fix_failed_devices() -> int:
+    print("Starting DNS remediation for failing eligible devices.")
+    devices = load_devices()
+    print(f"Checking {len(devices)} eligible device(s).")
+
+    fixed_count = 0
+    failed_count = 0
+
+    for device in devices:
+        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+        result = inspect_device(device)
+        print(
+            f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {result['name']} | IP address: {result['ip_address']} | "
+            f"Status: {result['status']} | DNS IP address: {result['dns']}"
+        )
+
+        if result["status"] == "SUCCESS":
+            continue
+
+        failed_count += 1
+        subject = f"DNS ALERT: {result['name']} ({result['ip_address']})"
+        body = (
+            "DNS remediation script detected a failing DNS configuration.\n\n"
+            f"Hostname: {result['name']}\n"
+            f"IP address: {result['ip_address']}\n"
+            f"Current DNS: {result['dns']}\n"
+            f"Expected DNS: {DNS1}, {DNS2}\n"
+            f"Reason: {result['reason']}\n"
+            f"Timestamp: {timestamp}\n"
+        )
+        email_sent = send_email(subject, body)
+        print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {result['name']} | Email alert: {'SENT' if email_sent else 'FAILED'}")
+
+        runtime_ip = result["ip_address"]
+        if runtime_ip in {"", "DHCP"}:
+            print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {result['name']} | Remediation skipped: no runtime IP")
+            continue
+
+        try:
+            host_ok, host_details = ensure_hostname_resolution(runtime_ip, device["username"], device["password"])
+        except Exception as exc:
+            host_ok, host_details = False, f"Pre-check error: {exc!r}"
+        print(
+            f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {result['name']} | Hostname resolution pre-check: "
+            f"{'SUCCESS' if host_ok else 'FAIL'} | {host_details}"
+        )
+
+        try:
+            changed, details = remediate_dns(runtime_ip, device["username"], device["password"])
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {result['name']} | Remediation failed: {exc!r}")
+            continue
+
+        print(
+            f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {result['name']} | Remediation command: "
+            f"{'SUCCESS' if changed else 'FAIL'} | {details}"
+        )
+
+        verify_timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+        verify_result = inspect_device(device)
+        print(
+            f"{verify_timestamp} | Hostname: {verify_result['name']} | IP address: {verify_result['ip_address']} | "
+            f"Post-fix status: {verify_result['status']} | DNS IP address: {verify_result['dns']}"
+        )
+
+        if verify_result["status"] == "SUCCESS":
+            fixed_count += 1
+            corrected_email_sent = send_corrected_email(
+                device_name=verify_result["name"],
+                ip_address=verify_result["ip_address"],
+                corrected_dns=f"{DNS1}, {DNS2}",
+                timestamp=verify_timestamp,
+            )
+            print(
+                f"{verify_timestamp} | Hostname: {verify_result['name']} | "
+                f"Correction email: {'SENT' if corrected_email_sent else 'FAILED'}"
+            )
+
+    print(f"DNS remediation summary: failing devices found = {failed_count}, fixed = {fixed_count}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def run_legacy_break_fix_workflow(device_name: str) -> int:
+    if not LEGACY_WORKFLOW_SCRIPT.exists():
+        print(f"Legacy workflow script not found: {LEGACY_WORKFLOW_SCRIPT}")
+        return 1
+
+    print(
+        "Running legacy break/fix workflow script "
+        f"for device '{device_name}' to perform alert + Helpdesk ticket lifecycle."
+    )
+    command = [sys.executable, str(LEGACY_WORKFLOW_SCRIPT), "--device-name", device_name]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, check=False)
+    print(f"Legacy workflow exit code: {result.returncode}")
+    return result.returncode
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    args = parse_args()
+
+    if not CSV_FILE.exists():
+        print(f"Inventory file not found: {CSV_FILE}")
+        return 1
+
+    remediation_code = fix_failed_devices()
+
+    if args.skip_legacy_workflow:
+        return remediation_code
+
+    workflow_code = run_legacy_break_fix_workflow(args.workflow_device_name)
+    return remediation_code if workflow_code == 0 else workflow_code
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Send DNS corrected email notification and verify SMTP acceptance."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import smtplib
+from datetime import datetime
+from email.message import EmailMessage
+
+
+SMTP_HOST = os.getenv("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.d522.wgu.internal")
+SMTP_PORT = int(os.getenv("SMTP_PORT", "1025"))
+SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 15
+FROM_ADDRESS = os.getenv("DNS_ALERT_FROM", "network-monitoring@localdomain")
+TO_ADDRESS = os.getenv("DNS_ALERT_TO", "stakeholders@localdomain")
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Generate and send DNS corrected emails with SMTP verification."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--device-name", required=True, help="Device name for the corrected email.")
+    parser.add_argument("--ip-address", required=True, help="Device IP address for the corrected email.")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--expected-dns",
+        default="10.10.10.10, 10.10.10.20",
+        help="Expected DNS setting text (default: 10.10.10.10, 10.10.10.20).",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--timestamp",
+        default="",
+        help="Timestamp text for the email body. If omitted, current time is used.",
+    )
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def build_email(device_name: str, ip_address: str, expected_dns: str, timestamp: str) -> EmailMessage:
+    message = EmailMessage()
+    message["Subject"] = f"DNS Configuration Corrected: {device_name} ({ip_address})"
+    message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
+    message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
+    message.set_content(
+        "Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"
+        "The DNS configuration issue previously detected on the following device has been automatically corrected:\n\n"
+        f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+        f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+        f"Corrected DNS Setting: {expected_dns}\n"
+        f"Time Corrected: {timestamp}\n\n"
+        "No further action is required at this time.\n\n"
+        "Best regards,\n"
+        "Network Monitoring System"
+    )
+    return message
+
+
+def send_email_and_verify(message: EmailMessage) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+    try:
+        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
+            code, banner = server.ehlo()
+            if code >= 400:
+                return False, f"SMTP EHLO failed with code {code} and banner {banner!r}"
+
+            failures = server.send_message(message)
+            if failures:
+                return False, f"SMTP rejected recipient(s): {failures}"
+
+            return True, f"SMTP accepted message via {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT}"
+    except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
+        return False, f"SMTP send failed: {exc}"
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    args = parse_args()
+    timestamp = args.timestamp or datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+
+    email_message = build_email(
+        device_name=args.device_name,
+        ip_address=args.ip_address,
+        expected_dns=args.expected_dns,
+        timestamp=timestamp,
+    )
+
+    sent, details = send_email_and_verify(email_message)
+    print(f"Email subject: {email_message['Subject']}")
+    print(f"SMTP verification: {'SUCCESS' if sent else 'FAIL'}")
+    print(f"Details: {details}")
+
+    return 0 if sent else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+-def close_dns_ticket(ticket_id: int, corrected_dns: str, timestamp: str) -> bool:
+-    payloads = [
+-        {"status": "closed", "resolution": f"DNS corrected to {corrected_dns} at {timestamp}"},
+-        {"status": "resolved", "resolution": f"DNS corrected to {corrected_dns} at {timestamp}"},
+-    ]
+-    attempts = [
+-        ("PATCH", f"/{ticket_id}"),
+-        ("PUT", f"/{ticket_id}"),
+-        ("POST", f"/{ticket_id}/close"),
+-    ]
+-
+-    last_status = 0
+-    last_response: object = {"error": "No close attempt made"}
+-    for method, path in attempts:
+-        for payload in payloads:
+-            try:
+-                status, response = api_request(method, path, payload)
+-            except RuntimeError as exc:
+-                print(f"TICKET API ERROR: {exc}")
+-                print("Verification: ticket closed = False")
+-                return False
+-            last_status, last_response = status, response
+-            if 200 <= status < 300:
+-                print(f"Ticket close HTTP status: {status}")
+-                print("Ticket close response:")
+-                print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
+-                print("Verification: ticket closed = True")
+-                return True
+-
+-    print(f"Ticket close HTTP status: {last_status}")
+-    print("Ticket close response:")
+-    print(json.dumps(last_response, indent=2))
+-    print("Verification: ticket closed = False")
+-    return False

+-def canonical_dns(dns_values: list[str]) -> str:
+-    if not dns_values:
+-        return "None"
+-    return ", ".join(sorted(set(dns_values)))

+-def check_dns_for_device(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bool, str, str, str]:
+-    """Return success flag, current_dns, expected_dns, and reason for a device."""
+-    name = device["name"]
+-    ip_address = device["address"]
+-    device_for_dns = {
+-        "name": name,
+-        "address": ip_address,
+-        "username": device.get("username") or DHCP_USERNAME,
+-        "password": device.get("password") or DHCP_PASSWORD,
+-    }
+ 
+-    current_dns = DNS_FIXER.read_dns_settings(device_for_dns)
+-    detected_dns = canonical_dns(current_dns)
+-    expected_dns = ", ".join(sorted(APPROVED_DNS))
+-
+-    if current_dns and set(current_dns) == APPROVED_DNS:
+-        ok, _ = DNS_FIXER.verify_dns(device_for_dns)
+-        if ok:
+-            return True, detected_dns, expected_dns, ""
+-        return False, detected_dns, expected_dns, "DNS verification failed"
+-
+-    if not current_dns:
+-        return False, "None", expected_dns, "No DNS server configured"
+-
+-    return False, detected_dns, expected_dns, "DNS does not match approved internal DNS"

++def resolve_dhcp_ip(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
++	access_port = device.get("access_port", "")
++	if not access_port:
++		return "", "Missing access port"
++
++	device_name = (device.get("name") or "").lower()
++	device_os = (device.get("os") or "").lower()

++		access_port_int = int(access_port)
++	except ValueError:
++		return "", f"Invalid access port: {access_port}"

++		access_port_int in VNC_PORT_RANGE

++			console.settimeout(0.5)
++			output = b""
++
++			def receive() -> None:
++				nonlocal output
++				while True:
++					try:
++						output += console.recv(4096)
++					except socket.timeout:
++						return

++			receive()

++			time.sleep(0.2)

++			console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
++			time.sleep(0.8)

++				ipaddress.IPv4Address(candidate)
++			except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
++				continue
++			if not candidate.startswith("127."):
++				return candidate, ""
++		return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
++	except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
++		return "", str(exc)

++def build_device_context(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
++	name = device["name"]
++	address = device["address"]

++		return name, {"name": name, "address": current_ip, "username": username, "password": password}

++				ip_address = context["address"]

++				else:
++					print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {name} | IP address: {ip_address} | Status: FAIL")

++				print("One-shot pass complete.")

++		print(f"ERROR: {exc}")
++	except KeyboardInterrupt:
++		print("DNS success logger stopped by user.")

+-
+-
+-API_HOSTS = [
+-	"api.d522.wgu.internal",
+-	"helpdesk.d522.wgu.internal",
+-]
+-API_PORT = 5000
+-TICKETS_PATH = "/api/tickets"
+-API_TOKEN = "vGkbXkGLqQSo7YLflp9DutuG8st4xdPPF7wnTcwB0FE"
+-
+-
+-def api_url_for(host: str) -> str:
+-	return f"http://{host}:{API_PORT}{TICKETS_PATH}"
+-
+-
+-def api_request(method: str, payload: dict | None = None, host: str = API_HOSTS[0]) -> tuple[int, object]:
+-	"""Send an authenticated API request and return the HTTP status and JSON body."""
+-	url = api_url_for(host)
+-	body = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+-	request = Request(
+-		url,
+-		data=body,
+-		method=method,
+-		headers={
+-			"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
+-			"Accept": "application/json",
+-			"Content-Type": "application/json",
+-		},
+-	)
+-
+-	try:
+-		with urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
+-			response_body = response.read().decode("utf-8")
+-			return response.status, json.loads(response_body) if response_body else {}
+-	except HTTPError as exc:
+-		error_body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+-		try:
+-			details = json.loads(error_body)
+-		except json.JSONDecodeError:
+-			details = {"error": error_body}
+-		return exc.code, details
+-	except URLError as exc:
+-		raise RuntimeError(f"Could not connect to {url}: {exc.reason}") from exc
+-
+-
+-def create_ticket(device_name: str, ip_address: str, reason: str, host: str = API_HOSTS[0]) -> tuple[int, object]:
+-	"""Create one helpdesk ticket for an unavailable device."""
+-	checked_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+-	payload = {
+-		"title": f"Network Device Unavailable: {device_name} ({ip_address})",
+-		"description": (
+-			"Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"
+-			"This is an automated notification that the following network device is currently unavailable:\n\n"
+-			f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+-			f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+-			f"Last Checked: {checked_at}\n"
+-			f"Failure Reason: {reason}\n\n"
+-			"Please investigate this issue at your earliest convenience.\n\n"
+-			"Best regards,\n"
+-			"Network Monitoring System"
+-		),
+-		"priority": "medium",
+-	}
+-	return api_request("POST", payload, host=host)

++def resolve_dhcp_ip(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
++    access_port = device.get("access_port", "")
++    if not access_port:
++        return "", "Missing access port"
++
++    device_name = (device.get("name") or "").lower()
++    device_os = (device.get("os") or "").lower()

++        access_port_int = int(access_port)
++    except ValueError:
++        return "", f"Invalid access port: {access_port}"
++
++    if (
++        access_port_int in VNC_PORT_RANGE
++        or "vnc" in device_name
++        or "webterm" in device_name
++        or "vnc" in device_os
++    ):
++        return "", "Non-CLI console endpoint (VNC/Webterm)"
++
++    try:
++        with socket.create_connection((CONSOLE_HOST, access_port_int), timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as console:
++            console.settimeout(0.5)
++            output = b""
++
++            def receive() -> None:
++                nonlocal output
++                while True:
++                    try:
++                        output += console.recv(4096)
++                    except socket.timeout:
++                        return
++
++            receive()
++            console.sendall(b"\n")
++            time.sleep(0.2)
++            console.sendall(f"{DHCP_USERNAME}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.2)
++            console.sendall(f"{DHCP_PASSWORD}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.6)
++            console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
++            time.sleep(0.8)
++            receive()
++
++        text = output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        matches = re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", text)
++        for candidate in reversed(matches):
++            try:
++                ipaddress.IPv4Address(candidate)
++            except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
++                continue
++            if not candidate.startswith("127."):
++                return candidate, ""
++        return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
++    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
++        return "", str(exc)

++"""Ping inventory devices, including DHCP clients discovered through GNS3."""
++
++import csv
++import re
++import socket
++import subprocess
++import time
++from pathlib import Path
++
++
++CSV_FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
++USERNAME = "ubuntu"
++PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
++CONSOLE_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
++CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
++
++
++def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
++    name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
++    return (
++        name.startswith("router")
++        or name.startswith("sw")
++        or "switch" in name
++        or name == "smtp"
++    )
++
++
++def get_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    """Return eligible devices, including entries whose address is DHCP."""
++    with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
++        reader = csv.DictReader(csvfile)
++        devices = []
++        for row in reader:
++            device_name = row.get("Device Name", "")
++            if should_exclude(device_name):
++                continue
++
++            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
++            if not address or address.lower() == "none":
++                continue
++
++            devices.append(
++                {
++                    "name": device_name.strip(),
++                    "address": address,
++                    "access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
++                }
++            )
++    return devices
++
++
++def discover_dhcp_address(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
++    """Use the GNS3 console and Ubuntu credentials to find a DHCP address."""
++    try:
++        with socket.create_connection(
++            (CONSOLE_HOST, int(device["access_port"])),
++            timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        ) as console:
++            console.settimeout(0.5)
++            output = b""
++
++            def receive() -> None:
++                nonlocal output
++                while True:
++                    try:
++                        output += console.recv(4096)
++                    except socket.timeout:
++                        return
++
++            receive()
++            console.sendall(f"{USERNAME}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.2)
++            console.sendall(f"{PASSWORD}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.5)
++            console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
++            time.sleep(0.5)
++            receive()
++
++        addresses = re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", output.decode(
++            "utf-8", errors="replace"
++        ))
++        if addresses:
++            return addresses[-1], ""
++        return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
++    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
++        return "", str(exc)
++
++
++def ping_host(ip_address: str) -> bool:
++    try:
++        result = subprocess.run(
++            ["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", ip_address],
++            capture_output=True,
++            text=True,
++            check=False,
++        )
++        return result.returncode == 0
++    except FileNotFoundError:
++        print("ping command not available on this system.")
++        return False
++
++
++if __name__ == "__main__":
++    for device in get_devices():
++        name = device["name"]
++        address = device["address"]
++
++        if address.lower() == "dhcp":
++            address, error = discover_dhcp_address(device)
++            if not address:
++                print(f"FAILED: {name} current DHCP address unavailable ({error})")
++                continue
++            print(f"{name} current DHCP address: {address}")
++
++        print(f"Pinging {name} ({address})...")
++        if ping_host(address):
++            print(f"SUCCESS: {name} reachable at {address}")
++        else:
++            print(f"FAILED: {name} unreachable at {address}")

++"""Print connectivity and DNS settings for devices in the inventory CSV."""

++import time
++from pathlib import Path
++

++
++
++CSV_FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
++ICMP_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("b1_icmp.py")
++PING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 1
++SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
++
++
++def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++	"""Load all devices from the inventory file."""
++	with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csv_file:
++		return [
++			{
++				"name": (row.get("Device Name") or "Unknown").strip(),
++				"address": (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip(),
++				"access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
++				"os": (row.get("OS") or "").strip(),
++				"username": (row.get("Username") or "").strip(),
++				"password": (row.get("Password") or "").strip(),
++			}
++			for row in csv.DictReader(csv_file)
++		]
++
++
++def run_icmp_script() -> str:
++	"""Run b1_icmp.py and return its standard output and errors."""
++	result = subprocess.run(
++		[sys.executable, str(ICMP_SCRIPT)],
++		capture_output=True,
++		text=True,
++		check=False,
++		cwd=str(ICMP_SCRIPT.parent),
++	)
++	return result.stdout + result.stderr
++
++
++def parse_icmp_output(output: str) -> dict[str, str]:
++	"""Extract addresses from successful fixed and DHCP ping results."""
++	addresses = {
++		match.group("name"): match.group("address")
++		for match in re.finditer(
++			r"^SUCCESS: (?P<name>[^ ]+) reachable at (?P<address>\S+)$",
++			output,
++			re.MULTILINE,
++		)
++	}
++	addresses.update(
++		{
++			match.group("name"): match.group("address")
++			for match in re.finditer(
++				r"^(?P<name>[^\s]+) current DHCP address: (?P<address>\S+)$",
++				output,
++				re.MULTILINE,
++			)
++		}
++	)
++	return addresses
++
++
++def run_console_command(device: dict[str, str], command: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
++	"""Run a command through the device's local GNS3 console."""
++	try:
++		with socket.create_connection(
++			("127.0.0.1", int(device["access_port"])), timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
++		) as console:
++			console.settimeout(0.5)
++			output = b""
++			try:
++				while True:
++					output += console.recv(4096)
++			except (socket.timeout, ConnectionResetError):
++				pass
++
++			console.sendall(f"{device['username']}\n".encode())
++			time.sleep(0.2)
++			console.sendall(f"{device['password']}\n".encode())
++			time.sleep(0.5)
++			console.sendall(f"{command}\n".encode())
++			time.sleep(0.5)
++			while True:
++				try:
++					output += console.recv(4096)
++				except socket.timeout:
++					break
++
++		return output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), ""
++	except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
++		return "", str(exc)
++
++
++def get_dhcp_details(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, list[str], str]:
++	"""Discover a DHCP address and DNS settings through the GNS3 console."""
++	output, error = run_console_command(
++		device,
++		"hostname -I; cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns 2>/dev/null",
++	)
++	first_line = output.splitlines()[0] if output.splitlines() else ""
++	address_match = re.search(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", first_line)
++	address = address_match.group(0) if address_match else ""
++	servers = re.findall(
++		r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE
++	)
++	return address, servers, error
++
++
++def ping_device(address: str) -> tuple[bool | None, str]:
++	"""Return the ping result and a reason when the address cannot be checked."""
++	if not address or address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
++		return None, "No fixed IP address"
++
++	try:
++		result = subprocess.run(
++			["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", str(PING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS), address],
++			capture_output=True,
++			text=True,
++			check=False,
++		)
++	except FileNotFoundError:
++		return None, "ping command is unavailable"
++
++	return result.returncode == 0, ""
++

++def dns_command(device_os: str) -> str:
++	"""Return the DNS command appropriate for the device operating system."""
++	if device_os.lower() == "vyos":
++		return "show system name-server"
++	return "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns 2>/dev/null"
++
++
++def read_dns_settings(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
++	"""Read DNS server entries over SSH and return entries plus an error message."""
++	client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++	client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++	try:
++		client.connect(
++			hostname=device["address"],
++			username=device["username"],
++			password=device["password"],
++			timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++			banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++			auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++		)
++		_, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
++			dns_command(device["os"]), timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
++		)
++		output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++		error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
++		servers = re.findall(
++			r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE
++		)
++		if not servers and device["os"].lower() == "vyos":
++			servers = re.findall(r"(?:name-server|nameserver)\s+(\S+)", output)
++		return servers, error
++	except Exception as exc:
++		return [], str(exc)
++	finally:
++		client.close()
++
++
++def print_device_status(device: dict[str, str]) -> None:
++	"""Print connectivity and DNS information for one inventory entry."""
++	name = device["name"]
++	is_dhcp = device["address"].lower() == "dhcp"
++	dns_servers: list[str] = []
++	dns_error = ""
++	if is_dhcp:
++		address, dns_servers, dns_error = get_dhcp_details(device)
++		if not address:
++			address = "Unknown"
++	else:

++# Creating a script to list devices whose DNS connection is not working properly.
++
++import csv
++import re
++import socket
++import time
++from pathlib import Path
++
++import paramiko
++
++
++CSV_FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
++APPROVED_DNS = {"10.10.10.10", "10.10.10.20"}
++USERNAME = "ubuntu"
++PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
++SSH_TIMEOUT = 10
++CONSOLE_TIMEOUT = 5
++
++
++def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
++    name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
++    return (
++        name.startswith("router")
++        or name.startswith("sw")
++        or "switch" in name
++        or name == "smtp"
++    )
++
++
++def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    devices = []
++    with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csv_file:
++        reader = csv.DictReader(csv_file)
++        for row in reader:
++            name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
++            if should_exclude(name):
++                continue
++
++            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
++            if not address or address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
++                continue
++
++            devices.append(
++                {
++                    "name": name,
++                    "address": address,
++                    "access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
++                    "username": (row.get("Username") or USERNAME).strip(),
++                    "password": (row.get("Password") or PASSWORD).strip(),
++                }
++            )
++    return devices
++
++
++def run_console_command(device: dict[str, str], command: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
++    try:
++        with socket.create_connection(
++            ("127.0.0.1", int(device["access_port"])),
++            timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT,
++        ) as console:
++            console.settimeout(0.5)
++            output = b""
++            try:
++                while True:
++                    output += console.recv(4096)
++            except (socket.timeout, ConnectionResetError):
++                pass
++
++            console.sendall(f"{device['username']}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.2)
++            console.sendall(f"{device['password']}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.5)
++            console.sendall(f"{command}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.5)
++            while True:
++                try:
++                    output += console.recv(4096)
++                except socket.timeout:
++                    break
++            return output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), ""
++    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
++        return "", str(exc)
++
++
++def get_dns_servers_from_device(device: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
++    if device["address"].lower() == "dhcp":
++        output, _ = run_console_command(device, "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns")
++        return re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE)
++
++    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++    try:
++        client.connect(
++            hostname=device["address"],
++            username=device["username"],
++            password=device["password"],
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++            banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++        )
++        _, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
++            "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns",
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++        )
++        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        return re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE)
++    except Exception:
++        return []
++    finally:
++        client.close()
++
++
++def dns_connection_ok(device: dict[str, str], dns_servers: list[str]) -> bool:
++    if not dns_servers:
++        return False
++
++    for dns_server in dns_servers:
++        if device["address"].lower() == "dhcp":
++            output, _ = run_console_command(
++                device,
++                f'ping -c 1 -W 1 "{dns_server}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo FAIL',
++            )
++            if "FAIL" in output:
++                return False
++        else:
++            client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++            client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++            try:
++                client.connect(
++                    hostname=device["address"],
++                    username=device["username"],
++                    password=device["password"],
++                    timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++                    banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++                    auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++                )
++                _, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
++                    f'ping -c 1 -W 1 "{dns_server}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo FAIL',
++                    timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++                )
++                output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++                if "FAIL" in output:
++                    return False
++            finally:
++                client.close()
++    return True
++
++
++def main() -> None:
++    bad_devices = []
++    for device in load_devices():
++        servers = get_dns_servers_from_device(device)
++        configured_ok = set(servers) == APPROVED_DNS
++        connected_ok = dns_connection_ok(device, servers)
++        if not configured_ok or not connected_ok:
++            bad_devices.append({
++                "name": device["name"],
++                "address": device["address"],
++                "dns": servers,
++                "status": "OFFLINE" if not connected_ok else "MISCONFIGURED",
++            })
++
++    if not bad_devices:
++        print("No devices are failing DNS connectivity.")
++    else:
++        print("Devices with DNS connection issues:")
++        for entry in bad_devices:
++            dns_value = entry["dns"][0] if entry["dns"] else "None"
++            print(f"Device name: {entry['name']}")
++            print(f"IP address of DNS: {dns_value}")
++            print(f"Status: {entry['status']}")
++            print()
++
++
++if __name__ == "__main__":
++    main()

++"""Restart a stopped internal DNS service and verify both DNS servers."""
++
++import subprocess
++import sys
++import shlex
++from pathlib import Path
++
++import paramiko
++
++
++DNS_SERVERS = [
++	{
++		"name": "DNS1",
++		"address": "10.10.10.10",
++		"hostname": "ns1.d522.wgu.internal",
++		"username": "ubuntu",
++		"password": "ubuntu",
++	},
++	{
++		"name": "DNS2",
++		"address": "10.10.10.20",
++		"hostname": "ns2.d522.wgu.internal",
++		"username": "ubuntu",
++		"password": "ubuntu",
++	},
++]
++
++SSH_PORT = 22
++SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
++VERIFY_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("d1_connect_dns.py")
++
++# Detect either service name, restart it only when it is not active, and
++# return the resulting state. sudo -S supports the supplied Ubuntu password.
++RESTART_COMMAND = """
++if systemctl list-unit-files bind9.service 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^bind9.service'; then
++    service=bind9
++elif systemctl list-unit-files named.service 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^named.service'; then
++    service=named
++else
++    echo 'No bind9.service or named.service unit was found.'
++    exit 1
++fi
++
++state=$(systemctl is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)
++echo "Service: $service"
++echo "Before restart: $state"
++if [ "$state" != "active" ]; then
++    echo "Restart services"
++    printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASSWORD" | sudo -S -p '' systemctl restart "$service"
++    state=$(systemctl is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)
++fi
++echo "After restart: $state"
++[ "$state" = "active" ]
++"""
++
++
++def restart_if_down(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
++	"""Restart the server's DNS service when down and return its final state."""
++	client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++	client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++
++	try:
++		client.connect(
++			hostname=server["address"],
++			port=SSH_PORT,
++			username=server["username"],
++			password=server["password"],
++			timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++			banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++			auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++		)
++		command = f"export SUDO_PASSWORD={shlex.quote(server['password'])}\n{RESTART_COMMAND}"
++		_, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(command, timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
++		output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
++		error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
++		print(output or "No restart output was returned.")
++		if error:
++			print(f"Command errors:\n{error}")
++		return stdout.channel.recv_exit_status() == 0
++	finally:
++		client.close()
++
++
++def verify_restart() -> int:
++	"""Rerun d1_connect_dns.py and print its separate DNS server results."""
++	if not VERIFY_SCRIPT.exists():
++		print("\nVerification script not found")
++		return 1
++	result = subprocess.run(
++		[sys.executable, str(VERIFY_SCRIPT)],
++		capture_output=True,
++		text=True,
++		check=False,
++		cwd=str(VERIFY_SCRIPT.parent),
++	)
++	print("\n===== DNS restart verification =====")
++	print(result.stdout.strip())
++	if result.stderr.strip():
++		print(f"\nVerification errors:\n{result.stderr.strip()}")
++	if result.returncode == 0:
++		print("\nServices restored successfully")
++	return result.returncode
++
++
++def main() -> int:
++	all_restarts_succeeded = True
++	for server in DNS_SERVERS:
++		print(f"\n{'=' * 60}\n{server['name']} - {server['hostname']} ({server['address']})\n{'=' * 60}")
++		try:
++			if not restart_if_down(server):
++				all_restarts_succeeded = False
++		except Exception as exc:
++			all_restarts_succeeded = False
++			print(f"Connection/restart failed: {exc}")
++
++	verification_status = verify_restart()
++	return 0 if all_restarts_succeeded and verification_status == 0 else 1
++
++
++if __name__ == "__main__":
++	raise SystemExit(main())

++def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    """Load non-infrastructure devices from the inventory CSV."""
++    csv_file = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
++    devices = []
++    with csv_file.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
++        import csv
++
++        for row in csv.DictReader(handle):
++            name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
++            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip().lower()
++            if not address or address in {"dhcp", "none"}:
++                continue
++            if name.lower().startswith("router") or name.lower().startswith("sw") or "switch" in name.lower() or name.lower() == "smtp":
++                continue
++            devices.append(
++                {
++                    "name": name,
++                    "address": address,
++                    "username": (row.get("Username") or USERNAME).strip() or USERNAME,
++                    "password": (row.get("Password") or PASSWORD).strip() or PASSWORD,
++                }
++            )
++    return devices
++
++
++def run_dns_check() -> str:
++    """Run the DNS verification script and return its combined output."""
++    if not DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT.exists():
++        return ""
++    result = subprocess.run(
++        [sys.executable, str(DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT)],
++        capture_output=True,
++        text=True,
++        check=False,
++        cwd=str(DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT.parent),
++    )
++    return result.stdout + result.stderr
++
++
++def find_misconfigured_devices(output: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    """Return devices marked MISCONFIGURED by the DNS check."""
++    pattern = re.compile(
++        r"^(?P<name>.+?) \((?P<address>[^)]+)\) - MISCONFIGURED\s*$",
++        re.MULTILINE,
++    )
++    return [
++        {"name": match.group("name").strip(), "address": match.group("address").strip()}
++        for match in pattern.finditer(output)
++    ]
++
++
++def run_remote_command(server: dict[str, str], command: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
++    """Run a sudo command on a device and return exit code and output."""
++    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++    try:
++        client.connect(
++            hostname=server["address"],
++            username=server["username"],
++            password=server["password"],
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++            banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        )
++        stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
++            f"sudo -S -p '' sh -c {shlex.quote(command)}",
++            get_pty=True,
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        )
++        stdin.write(f"{server['password']}\n")
++        stdin.flush()
++        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        return stdout.channel.recv_exit_status(), output.strip(), error.strip()
++    finally:
++        client.close()

++def configure_dns(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:

++    command = (
++        f"printf '%s\\n' 'nameserver {DNS1}' 'nameserver {DNS2}' "

++    )
++    status, output, error = run_remote_command(server, command)
++    if output:
++        print(output)
++    if error:
++        print(f"Command errors: {error}")
++    return status == 0
++
++
++def verify_dns(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:

++    status, output, error = run_remote_command(server, "cat /etc/resolv.conf")

++    correct = status == 0 and set(servers) == {DNS1, DNS2}
++    result = "SUCCESS" if correct else "FAILED"
++    print(f"{server['name']} ({server['address']}) - {result}")
++    print(f"  DNS servers: {servers or 'None'}")
++    if error:
++        print(f"  Verification errors: {error}")
++    return correct
++
++
++def main() -> int:
++    devices = load_devices()

++        return 0

++        print("No devices are currently misconfigured; all DNS settings are already correct.")
++        return 0

++    print(f"Found {len(misconfigured_devices)} device(s) with incorrect DNS settings.")
++    configuration_results = []
++    verification_results = []
++
++    for device in misconfigured_devices:
++        print(f"\n{'=' * 60}\n{device['name']} ({device['address']})\n{'=' * 60}")
++        try:
++            target = next(item for item in devices if item["name"].lower() == device["name"].lower())
++            connected_and_configured = configure_dns(target)
++            if not connected_and_configured:
++                print("Unable to update DNS settings.")
++            configuration_results.append(connected_and_configured)
++            verification_results.append(verify_dns(target))
++            print(f"DEVICE SUCCESS: {device['name']} updated to DNS1 ({DNS1}) and DNS2 ({DNS2}).")
++        except Exception as exc:
++            print(f"Connection/configuration failed for {device['name']}: {exc}")
++            configuration_results.append(False)
++            verification_results.append(False)
++
++    print("\n===== DNS verification summary =====")
++    if verification_results and all(verification_results):
++        print("All devices have the correct internal DNS settings and report success.")
++        return 0
++
++    failed = sum(1 for result in verification_results if not result)
++    print(f"{failed} device(s) did not resolve to the expected DNS settings.")
++    return 1
++

++    raise SystemExit(main())

++def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    """Load eligible devices from the inventory CSV."""
++    devices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
++    with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csv_file:
++        for row in csv.DictReader(csv_file):
++            name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
++            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
++            if not address or address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
++                continue
++            lower_name = name.lower()
++            if lower_name.startswith("router") or lower_name.startswith("sw") or "switch" in lower_name or lower_name == "smtp":
++                continue
++            devices.append(
++                {
++                    "name": name,
++                    "address": address,
++                    "username": (row.get("Username") or USERNAME).strip() or USERNAME,
++                    "password": (row.get("Password") or PASSWORD).strip() or PASSWORD,

++def read_dns_settings(device: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
++    """Read nameserver entries from /etc/resolv.conf on the device."""
++    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++    try:
++        client.connect(
++            hostname=device["address"],
++            username=device["username"],
++            password=device["password"],
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++            banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        )
++        _, stdout, _ = client.exec_command(
++            "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns",
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        )
++        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        return re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, re.MULTILINE)
++    except Exception:
++        return []
++    finally:
++        client.close()

++def set_internal_dns(device: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
++    """Write the internal DNS servers to the device's resolv.conf file."""
++    command = (
++        f"printf '%s\\n' 'nameserver {DNS1}' 'nameserver {DNS2}' "
++        "'options timeout:2 attempts:2' > /etc/resolv.conf"
++    )

++            username=device["username"],
++            password=device["password"],

++            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,

++        stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
++            f"sudo -S -p '' sh -c {shlex.quote(command)}",
++            get_pty=True,
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        )
++        stdin.write(f"{device['password']}\n")
++        stdin.flush()

++        error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

++        if output.strip():
++            print(output.strip())
++        if error.strip():
++            print(error.strip())
++        return exit_code == 0
++    except Exception as exc:
++        print(f"Failed to update DNS on {device['name']}: {exc}")
++        return False
++    finally:
++        client.close()

++def dns_is_reachable(dns_ip: str) -> bool:
++    """Check whether a DNS server is reachable via ping."""
++    result = subprocess.run(
++        ["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", dns_ip],
++        capture_output=True,
++        text=True,
++        check=False,
++    )
++    return result.returncode == 0

++def verify_dns(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
++    """Verify the device points to the approved internal DNS servers and that they respond."""
++    servers = read_dns_settings(device)
++    reachable = all(dns_is_reachable(server) for server in servers) if servers else False
++    correct = set(servers) == APPROVED_DNS and reachable
++    return correct, servers

++def main() -> None:
++    """Fix misconfigured DNS settings and print the result for each affected device."""
++    print("Connecting to devices with incorrect DNS settings...\n")

++        if changed:
++            current_dns = read_dns_settings(device)
++        success, final_dns = verify_dns(device)
++        final_status = "SUCCESS" if success and changed else "FAILED"
++
++        print(f"Device name: {device['name']}")
++        print(f"IP address of DNS: {', '.join(final_dns) if final_dns else 'None'}")
++        print(f"Status: {final_status}")
++        print()

++"""Email stakeholders after verifying that device DNS settings were resolved."""

++import sys

++from d4_verify_new_dns import load_devices, verify_dns

++TO_ADDRESS = "stakeholders@localdomain"
++SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
++SUBJECT = "RESOLVED: DNS Service Issue and Device Compromise—All Issues Remediated"
++
++
++def get_resolved_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    """Use d4_verify_new_dns.py's inventory and verification logic to generate the resolved device list."""
++    resolved_devices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
++    for device in load_devices():
++        try:
++            is_resolved, _ = verify_dns(device)
++        except Exception as exc:
++            print(f"Could not verify {device['name']} ({device['address']}): {exc}")
++            continue
++
++        if is_resolved:
++            resolved_devices.append(device)
++    return resolved_devices
++
++
++def build_email(devices: list[dict[str, str]]) -> EmailMessage:
++    """Build one resolution email containing all successfully remediated devices."""
++    device_list = "\n".join(
++        f"- Hostname: {device['name']} | IP address: {device['address']}"
++        for device in devices
++    )
++    body = (
++        "Dear Stakeholders,\n\n"
++        "This is an automated notification to inform you that the DNS service issue and all related device compromises have been successfully resolved.\n\n"
++        "The following devices were affected and have now been remediated:\n\n"
++        f"{device_list}\n\n"
++        "No further action is required at this time. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the IT support team.\n\n"
++        "Thank you for your attention.\n\n"
++        "Best regards,\n"
++        "Network Monitoring System"
++    )
++    message = EmailMessage()
++    message["Subject"] = SUBJECT
++    message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
++    message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
++    message.set_content(body)
++    return message
++
++
++def send_resolution_emails(devices: list[dict[str, str]]) -> bool:
++    """Send a resolution email for the resolved devices and verify the SMTP server accepted it."""
++    if not devices:
++        print("No devices with resolved DNS settings were found; no emails sent.")
++        return True
++
++    all_sent = True
++    try:
++        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
++            server.ehlo()
++            print(f"Connected to email server {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT}")
++            message = build_email(devices)
++            refused = server.send_message(message)
++            accepted = not refused
++            status = "SUCCESS" if accepted else "FAILED"
++            print(
++                f"{status}: resolution email for {len(devices)} device(s) accepted by the email server"
++            )
++            all_sent = all_sent and accepted
++    except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
++        print(f"FAILED: could not connect to {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
++        return False
++    return all_sent
++
++
++def main() -> int:
++    devices = get_resolved_devices()
++    print(f"Found {len(devices)} device(s) with resolved DNS settings.")
++    return 0 if send_resolution_emails(devices) else 1

++#!/usr/bin/env python3
++import time
++import requests
++
++GNS3_SERVER = "http://localhost:3080"
++PROJECT_ID = "980fb060-20d5-4268-8ba6-f215a2b4f9c3"
++
++SERVER_NODES = ["DNS1", "DNS2", "API", "DB", "SMTP", "SVR1", "SVR2"]
++ROUTER_NODE = "ROUTER1" # dhcp service
++SWITCH_NODES = ["SW1", "SW2", "SW3", "SW4"]
++DHCP_CLIENT_NODES = ["PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "WEBTERM"]
++
++DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START = 120  # seconds
++
++session = requests.Session()
++
++def get_nodes():
++    r = session.get(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes")
++    r.raise_for_status()
++    return r.json()
++
++def find_node_by_name(nodes, name):
++    for node in nodes:
++        if node["name"] == name:
++            return node
++    raise ValueError(f"Node not found: {name}")
++
++def start_node(node_id, node_name):
++    r = session.post(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes/{node_id}/start")
++    r.raise_for_status()
++    print(f"Started: {node_name}")
++
++def print_green(msg):
++    print(f"\033[92m{'\n' + msg}\033[0m")
++
++def main():
++    nodes = get_nodes()
++
++    print_green("Starting network switches...")
++    for name in SWITCH_NODES:
++        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
++        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
++
++    print_green("Starting server nodes...")
++    for name in SERVER_NODES:
++        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
++        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
++
++    print_green("Starting network router and dhcp...")
++    dhcp_node = find_node_by_name(nodes,ROUTER_NODE)
++    start_node(dhcp_node["node_id"], dhcp_node["name"])
++
++    interval = 5
++    remaining = DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START
++
++    print(f"Waiting {DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START} seconds for DHCP service to come up...")
++    while remaining > 0:
++        print(f"  ⏳ {remaining} seconds remaining...")
++        sleep_time = min(interval, remaining)
++        time.sleep(sleep_time)
++        remaining -= sleep_time
++
++    print("Done waiting for DHCP service.")
++
++    print_green("\nStarting DHCP clients...")
++    for name in DHCP_CLIENT_NODES:
++        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
++        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
++
++    print_green("GNS3 network startup complete.")
++
++if __name__ == "__main__":
++    main()

++#!/usr/bin/env python3
++import time
++import requests
++
++GNS3_SERVER = "http://localhost:3080"
++PROJECT_ID = "980fb060-20d5-4268-8ba6-f215a2b4f9c3"
++
++SERVER_NODES = ["DNS1", "DNS2", "API", "DB", "SMTP", "SVR1", "SVR2"]
++ROUTER_NODE = "ROUTER1" # dhcp service
++SWITCH_NODES = ["SW1", "SW2", "SW3", "SW4"]
++DHCP_CLIENT_NODES = ["PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "WEBTERM"]
++
++DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START = 120  # seconds
++
++session = requests.Session()
++
++def get_nodes():
++    r = session.get(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes")
++    r.raise_for_status()
++    return r.json()
++
++def find_node_by_name(nodes, name):
++    for node in nodes:
++        if node["name"] == name:
++            return node
++    raise ValueError(f"Node not found: {name}")
++
++def start_node(node_id, node_name):
++    r = session.post(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes/{node_id}/start")
++    r.raise_for_status()
++    print(f"Started: {node_name}")
++
++def print_green(msg):
++    print(f"\033[92m{'\n' + msg}\033[0m")
++
++def main():
++    nodes = get_nodes()
++
++    print_green("Starting network switches...")
++    for name in SWITCH_NODES:
++        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
++        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
++
++    print_green("Starting server nodes...")
++    for name in SERVER_NODES:
++        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
++        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
++
++    print_green("Starting network router and dhcp...")
++    dhcp_node = find_node_by_name(nodes,ROUTER_NODE)
++    start_node(dhcp_node["node_id"], dhcp_node["name"])
++
++    interval = 5
++    remaining = DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START
++
++    print(f"Waiting {DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START} seconds for DHCP service to come up...")
++    while remaining > 0:
++        print(f"  ⏳ {remaining} seconds remaining...")
++        sleep_time = min(interval, remaining)
++        time.sleep(sleep_time)
++        remaining -= sleep_time
++
++    print("Done waiting for DHCP service.")
++
++    print_green("\nStarting DHCP clients...")
++    for name in DHCP_CLIENT_NODES:
++        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
++        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
++
++    print_green("GNS3 network startup complete.")
++

++    main()

+-def resolve_dhcp_ip(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:

+-def close_dns_ticket(ticket_id: int, corrected_dns: str, timestamp: str) -> bool:
+-    payloads = [
+-        {"status": "closed", "resolution": f"DNS corrected to {corrected_dns} at {timestamp}"},
+-        {"status": "resolved", "resolution": f"DNS corrected to {corrected_dns} at {timestamp}"},
+-    ]
+-    attempts = [
+-        ("PATCH", f"/{ticket_id}"),
+-        ("PUT", f"/{ticket_id}"),
+-        ("POST", f"/{ticket_id}/close"),

++def resolve_dhcp_ip(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
++	access_port = device.get("access_port", "")
++	if not access_port:
++		return "", "Missing access port"
++
++	device_name = (device.get("name") or "").lower()
++	device_os = (device.get("os") or "").lower()

++		access_port_int = int(access_port)

++		return "", f"Invalid access port: {access_port}"

++						return

+-

+-
+-
+-API_HOSTS = [
+-	"api.d522.wgu.internal",
+-	"helpdesk.d522.wgu.internal",
+-]
+-API_PORT = 5000
+-TICKETS_PATH = "/api/tickets"
+-API_TOKEN = "vGkbXkGLqQSo7YLflp9DutuG8st4xdPPF7wnTcwB0FE"
+-
+-
+-def api_url_for(host: str) -> str:
+-	return f"http://{host}:{API_PORT}{TICKETS_PATH}"
+-
+-
+-def api_request(method: str, payload: dict | None = None, host: str = API_HOSTS[0]) -> tuple[int, object]:
+-	"""Send an authenticated API request and return the HTTP status and JSON body."""
+-	url = api_url_for(host)
+-	body = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+-	request = Request(
+-		url,
+-		data=body,
+-		method=method,
+-		headers={
+-			"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
+-			"Accept": "application/json",
+-			"Content-Type": "application/json",
+-		},
+-	)
+-
+-	try:
+-		with urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
+-			response_body = response.read().decode("utf-8")
+-			return response.status, json.loads(response_body) if response_body else {}
+-	except HTTPError as exc:
+-		error_body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+-		try:
+-			details = json.loads(error_body)
+-		except json.JSONDecodeError:
+-			details = {"error": error_body}
+-		return exc.code, details
+-	except URLError as exc:
+-		raise RuntimeError(f"Could not connect to {url}: {exc.reason}") from exc
+-
+-
+-def create_ticket(device_name: str, ip_address: str, reason: str, host: str = API_HOSTS[0]) -> tuple[int, object]:
+-	"""Create one helpdesk ticket for an unavailable device."""
+-	checked_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+-	payload = {
+-		"title": f"Network Device Unavailable: {device_name} ({ip_address})",
+-		"description": (
+-			"Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"
+-			"This is an automated notification that the following network device is currently unavailable:\n\n"
+-			f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+-			f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+-			f"Last Checked: {checked_at}\n"
+-			f"Failure Reason: {reason}\n\n"
+-			"Please investigate this issue at your earliest convenience.\n\n"
+-			"Best regards,\n"
+-			"Network Monitoring System"
+-		),
+-		"priority": "medium",
+-	}
+-	return api_request("POST", payload, host=host)

++def resolve_dhcp_ip(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
++    access_port = device.get("access_port", "")
++    if not access_port:
++        return "", "Missing access port"
++
++    device_name = (device.get("name") or "").lower()
++    device_os = (device.get("os") or "").lower()
++    try:
++        access_port_int = int(access_port)
++    except ValueError:
++        return "", f"Invalid access port: {access_port}"
++
++    if (
++        access_port_int in VNC_PORT_RANGE
++        or "vnc" in device_name
++        or "webterm" in device_name
++        or "vnc" in device_os
++    ):
++        return "", "Non-CLI console endpoint (VNC/Webterm)"
++
++    try:
++        with socket.create_connection((CONSOLE_HOST, access_port_int), timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as console:
++            console.settimeout(0.5)
++            output = b""
++
++            def receive() -> None:
++                nonlocal output
++                while True:
++                    try:
++                        output += console.recv(4096)
++                    except socket.timeout:
++                        return
++
++            receive()
++            console.sendall(b"\n")
++            time.sleep(0.2)
++            console.sendall(f"{DHCP_USERNAME}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.2)
++            console.sendall(f"{DHCP_PASSWORD}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.6)
++            console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
++            time.sleep(0.8)
++            receive()
++
++        text = output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        matches = re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", text)
++        for candidate in reversed(matches):
++            try:
++                ipaddress.IPv4Address(candidate)
++            except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
++                continue
++            if not candidate.startswith("127."):
++                return candidate, ""
++        return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
++    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
++        return "", str(exc)

++def build_device_context(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

++    return name, {"name": name, "address": address, "username": username, "password": password}

++def check_dns_for_device(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bool, str, str, str]:

++			def receive() -> None:

++						return

++	except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
++		return "", str(exc)

++"""Ping inventory devices, including DHCP clients discovered through GNS3."""
++
++import csv
++import re
++import socket
++import subprocess
++import time
++from pathlib import Path
++
++
++CSV_FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
++USERNAME = "ubuntu"
++PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
++CONSOLE_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
++CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
++
++
++def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
++    name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
++    return (
++        name.startswith("router")
++        or name.startswith("sw")
++        or "switch" in name
++        or name == "smtp"
++    )
++
++
++def get_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    """Return eligible devices, including entries whose address is DHCP."""
++    with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
++        reader = csv.DictReader(csvfile)
++        devices = []
++        for row in reader:
++            device_name = row.get("Device Name", "")
++            if should_exclude(device_name):
++                continue
++
++            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
++            if not address or address.lower() == "none":
++                continue
++
++            devices.append(
++                {
++                    "name": device_name.strip(),
++                    "address": address,
++                    "access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
++                }
++            )
++    return devices
++
++
++def discover_dhcp_address(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
++    """Use the GNS3 console and Ubuntu credentials to find a DHCP address."""
++    try:
++        with socket.create_connection(
++            (CONSOLE_HOST, int(device["access_port"])),
++            timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        ) as console:
++            console.settimeout(0.5)
++            output = b""
++
++            def receive() -> None:
++                nonlocal output
++                while True:
++                    try:
++                        output += console.recv(4096)
++                    except socket.timeout:
++                        return
++
++            receive()
++            console.sendall(f"{USERNAME}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.2)
++            console.sendall(f"{PASSWORD}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.5)
++            console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
++            time.sleep(0.5)
++            receive()
++
++        addresses = re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", output.decode(
++            "utf-8", errors="replace"
++        ))
++        if addresses:
++            return addresses[-1], ""
++        return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
++    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
++        return "", str(exc)
++
++
++def ping_host(ip_address: str) -> bool:
++    try:
++        result = subprocess.run(
++            ["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", ip_address],
++            capture_output=True,
++            text=True,
++            check=False,
++        )
++        return result.returncode == 0
++    except FileNotFoundError:
++        print("ping command not available on this system.")
++        return False
++
++
++if __name__ == "__main__":
++    for device in get_devices():
++        name = device["name"]
++        address = device["address"]
++
++        if address.lower() == "dhcp":
++            address, error = discover_dhcp_address(device)
++            if not address:
++                print(f"FAILED: {name} current DHCP address unavailable ({error})")
++                continue
++            print(f"{name} current DHCP address: {address}")
++
++        print(f"Pinging {name} ({address})...")

++            print(f"FAILED: {name} unreachable at {address}")

++def parse_icmp_output(output: str) -> dict[str, str]:

++def run_console_command(device: dict[str, str], command: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
++	"""Run a command through the device's local GNS3 console."""
