++def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
++    name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
++    return (
++        name.startswith("router")
++        or name.startswith("sw")
++        or "switch" in name
++        or name == "smtp"

++    devices = []
++    with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csv_file:
++        reader = csv.DictReader(csv_file)
++        for row in reader:
++            name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
++            if should_exclude(name):
++                continue
++
++            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
++            if not address or address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
++                continue
++
++            devices.append(

++                    "name": name,
++                    "address": address,
++                    "access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
++                    "username": (row.get("Username") or USERNAME).strip(),
++                    "password": (row.get("Password") or PASSWORD).strip(),

++            )

++def run_console_command(device: dict[str, str], command: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
++    try:
++        with socket.create_connection(
++            ("127.0.0.1", int(device["access_port"])),
++            timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT,
++        ) as console:
++            console.settimeout(0.5)
++            output = b""
++            try:
++                while True:
++                    output += console.recv(4096)
++            except (socket.timeout, ConnectionResetError):
++                pass
++
++            console.sendall(f"{device['username']}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.2)
++            console.sendall(f"{device['password']}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.5)
++            console.sendall(f"{command}\n".encode())
++            time.sleep(0.5)
++            while True:
++                try:
++                    output += console.recv(4096)
++                except socket.timeout:
++                    break
++            return output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), ""
++    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
++        return "", str(exc)

++def get_dns_servers_from_device(device: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
++    if device["address"].lower() == "dhcp":
++        output, _ = run_console_command(device, "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns")
++        return re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE)
++
++    client = paramiko.SSHClient()

++    try:
++        client.connect(

++            username=device["username"],
++            password=device["password"],
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++            banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++        )
++        _, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
++            "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns",
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++        )
++        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        return re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE)
++    except Exception:
++        return []
++    finally:
++        client.close()
++

++def dns_connection_ok(device: dict[str, str], dns_servers: list[str]) -> bool:
++    if not dns_servers:
++        return False
++
++    for dns_server in dns_servers:
++        if device["address"].lower() == "dhcp":
++            output, _ = run_console_command(
++                device,
++                f'ping -c 1 -W 1 "{dns_server}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo FAIL',
++            )
++            if "FAIL" in output:
++                return False
++        else:
++            client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++            client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++            try:
++                client.connect(
++                    hostname=device["address"],
++                    username=device["username"],
++                    password=device["password"],
++                    timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++                    banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++                    auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++                )
++                _, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
++                    f'ping -c 1 -W 1 "{dns_server}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo FAIL',
++                    timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
++                )
++                output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++                if "FAIL" in output:
++                    return False
++            finally:
++                client.close()
++    return True

++            print(f"Status: {entry['status']}")

++    main()

++def get_dns_status(server: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
++	"""Connect to one server and return its hostname, stdout, and stderr."""
++	client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++	client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++
++	try:
++		client.connect(
++			hostname=server["address"],
++			port=SSH_PORT,
++			username=server["username"],
++			password=server["password"],
++			timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++			banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++			auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++		)
++		_, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(STATUS_COMMAND, timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
++		return (
++			stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip(),
++			stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip(),

++"""Restart a stopped internal DNS service and verify both DNS servers."""
++
++import subprocess
++import sys
++import shlex
++from pathlib import Path
++
++import paramiko
++
++
++DNS_SERVERS = [
++	{
++		"name": "DNS1",
++		"address": "10.10.10.10",
++		"hostname": "ns1.d522.wgu.internal",
++		"username": "ubuntu",
++		"password": "ubuntu",
++	},
++	{
++		"name": "DNS2",
++		"address": "10.10.10.20",
++		"hostname": "ns2.d522.wgu.internal",
++		"username": "ubuntu",
++		"password": "ubuntu",
++	},
++]
++
++SSH_PORT = 22
++SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
++VERIFY_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("d1_connect_dns.py")
++
++# Detect either service name, restart it only when it is not active, and
++# return the resulting state. sudo -S supports the supplied Ubuntu password.
++RESTART_COMMAND = """
++if systemctl list-unit-files bind9.service 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^bind9.service'; then
++    service=bind9
++elif systemctl list-unit-files named.service 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^named.service'; then
++    service=named
++else
++    echo 'No bind9.service or named.service unit was found.'
++    exit 1
++fi
++
++state=$(systemctl is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)
++echo "Service: $service"
++echo "Before restart: $state"
++if [ "$state" != "active" ]; then
++    echo "Restart services"
++    printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASSWORD" | sudo -S -p '' systemctl restart "$service"
++    state=$(systemctl is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)
++fi
++echo "After restart: $state"
++[ "$state" = "active" ]
++"""
++
++
++def restart_if_down(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
++	"""Restart the server's DNS service when down and return its final state."""
++	client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++	client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++
++	try:
++		client.connect(
++			hostname=server["address"],
++			port=SSH_PORT,
++			username=server["username"],
++			password=server["password"],
++			timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++			banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++			auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++		)
++		command = f"export SUDO_PASSWORD={shlex.quote(server['password'])}\n{RESTART_COMMAND}"
++		_, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(command, timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
++		output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
++		error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
++		print(output or "No restart output was returned.")
++		if error:
++			print(f"Command errors:\n{error}")
++		return stdout.channel.recv_exit_status() == 0
++	finally:
++		client.close()
++
++
++def verify_restart() -> int:
++	"""Rerun d1_connect_dns.py and print its separate DNS server results."""
++	if not VERIFY_SCRIPT.exists():
++		print("\nVerification script not found")
++		return 1
++	result = subprocess.run(
++		[sys.executable, str(VERIFY_SCRIPT)],
++		capture_output=True,
++		text=True,
++		check=False,
++		cwd=str(VERIFY_SCRIPT.parent),
++	)
++	print("\n===== DNS restart verification =====")
++	print(result.stdout.strip())
++	if result.stderr.strip():
++		print(f"\nVerification errors:\n{result.stderr.strip()}")
++	if result.returncode == 0:
++		print("\nServices restored successfully")
++	return result.returncode
++
++
++def main() -> int:
++	all_restarts_succeeded = True
++	for server in DNS_SERVERS:
++		print(f"\n{'=' * 60}\n{server['name']} - {server['hostname']} ({server['address']})\n{'=' * 60}")
++		try:
++			if not restart_if_down(server):
++				all_restarts_succeeded = False
++		except Exception as exc:
++			all_restarts_succeeded = False
++			print(f"Connection/restart failed: {exc}")
++
++	verification_status = verify_restart()
++	return 0 if all_restarts_succeeded and verification_status == 0 else 1

++	raise SystemExit(main())

++

++def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    """Load non-infrastructure devices from the inventory CSV."""
++    csv_file = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
++    devices = []
++    with csv_file.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
++        import csv
++
++        for row in csv.DictReader(handle):
++            name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
++            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip().lower()
++            if not address or address in {"dhcp", "none"}:
++                continue
++            if name.lower().startswith("router") or name.lower().startswith("sw") or "switch" in name.lower() or name.lower() == "smtp":
++                continue
++            devices.append(
++                {
++                    "name": name,
++                    "address": address,
++                    "username": (row.get("Username") or USERNAME).strip() or USERNAME,
++                    "password": (row.get("Password") or PASSWORD).strip() or PASSWORD,
++                }
++            )
++    return devices
++
++
++def run_dns_check() -> str:
++    """Run the DNS verification script and return its combined output."""
++    if not DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT.exists():
++        return ""
++    result = subprocess.run(
++        [sys.executable, str(DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT)],
++        capture_output=True,
++        text=True,
++        check=False,
++        cwd=str(DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT.parent),
++    )
++    return result.stdout + result.stderr
++
++
++def find_misconfigured_devices(output: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    """Return devices marked MISCONFIGURED by the DNS check."""
++    pattern = re.compile(
++        r"^(?P<name>.+?) \((?P<address>[^)]+)\) - MISCONFIGURED\s*$",
++        re.MULTILINE,
++    )
++    return [
++        {"name": match.group("name").strip(), "address": match.group("address").strip()}
++        for match in pattern.finditer(output)
++    ]
++
++
++def run_remote_command(server: dict[str, str], command: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
++    """Run a sudo command on a device and return exit code and output."""
++    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
++    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
++    try:
++        client.connect(
++            hostname=server["address"],
++            username=server["username"],
++            password=server["password"],
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++            banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        )
++        stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
++            f"sudo -S -p '' sh -c {shlex.quote(command)}",
++            get_pty=True,
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        )
++        stdin.write(f"{server['password']}\n")
++        stdin.flush()
++        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        return stdout.channel.recv_exit_status(), output.strip(), error.strip()
++    finally:
++        client.close()
++

++def configure_dns(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
++    """Set both approved DNS servers in /etc/resolv.conf."""
++    command = (
++        f"printf '%s\\n' 'nameserver {DNS1}' 'nameserver {DNS2}' "
++        "'options timeout:2 attempts:2' > /etc/resolv.conf"
++    )
++    status, output, error = run_remote_command(server, command)
++    if output:
++        print(output)
++    if error:
++        print(f"Command errors: {error}")
++    return status == 0
++
++
++def verify_dns(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
++    """Verify that /etc/resolv.conf contains DNS1 and DNS2 only."""
++    status, output, error = run_remote_command(server, "cat /etc/resolv.conf")
++    servers = re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, re.MULTILINE)
++    correct = status == 0 and set(servers) == {DNS1, DNS2}
++    result = "SUCCESS" if correct else "FAILED"
++    print(f"{server['name']} ({server['address']}) - {result}")
++    print(f"  DNS servers: {servers or 'None'}")
++    if error:
++        print(f"  Verification errors: {error}")
++    return correct
++
++
++def main() -> int:
++    devices = load_devices()
++    if not devices:
++        print("No eligible devices were found in network_devices.csv.")
++        return 0
++
++    print("Checking DNS settings on all eligible devices...")
++    check_output = run_dns_check()
++    misconfigured_devices = find_misconfigured_devices(check_output)

++        print("No devices are currently misconfigured; all DNS settings are already correct.")
++        return 0
++
++    print(f"Found {len(misconfigured_devices)} device(s) with incorrect DNS settings.")
++    configuration_results = []
++    verification_results = []
++
++    for device in misconfigured_devices:
++        print(f"\n{'=' * 60}\n{device['name']} ({device['address']})\n{'=' * 60}")
++        try:
++            target = next(item for item in devices if item["name"].lower() == device["name"].lower())
++            connected_and_configured = configure_dns(target)
++            if not connected_and_configured:
++                print("Unable to update DNS settings.")
++            configuration_results.append(connected_and_configured)
++            verification_results.append(verify_dns(target))
++            print(f"DEVICE SUCCESS: {device['name']} updated to DNS1 ({DNS1}) and DNS2 ({DNS2}).")
++        except Exception as exc:
++            print(f"Connection/configuration failed for {device['name']}: {exc}")
++            configuration_results.append(False)
++            verification_results.append(False)
++
++    print("\n===== DNS verification summary =====")
++    if verification_results and all(verification_results):
++        print("All devices have the correct internal DNS settings and report success.")
++        return 0
++
++    failed = sum(1 for result in verification_results if not result)
++    print(f"{failed} device(s) did not resolve to the expected DNS settings.")
++    return 1
++

++    raise SystemExit(main())

++        stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
++            f"sudo -S -p '' sh -c {shlex.quote(command)}",
++            get_pty=True,
++            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
++        )
++        stdin.write(f"{device['password']}\n")
++        stdin.flush()
++        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
++        exit_code = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
++        if output.strip():
++            print(output.strip())
++        if error.strip():
++            print(error.strip())
++        return exit_code == 0
++    except Exception as exc:
++        print(f"Failed to update DNS on {device['name']}: {exc}")
++        return False
++    finally:
++        client.close()
++
++
++def dns_is_reachable(dns_ip: str) -> bool:
++    """Check whether a DNS server is reachable via ping."""
++    result = subprocess.run(
++        ["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", dns_ip],
++        capture_output=True,
++        text=True,
++        check=False,
++    )
++    return result.returncode == 0
++
++
++def verify_dns(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
++    """Verify the device points to the approved internal DNS servers and that they respond."""
++    servers = read_dns_settings(device)
++    reachable = all(dns_is_reachable(server) for server in servers) if servers else False
++    correct = set(servers) == APPROVED_DNS and reachable
++    return correct, servers
++

++"""Email stakeholders after verifying that device DNS settings were resolved."""

++TO_ADDRESS = "stakeholders@localdomain"
++SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
++SUBJECT = "RESOLVED: DNS Service Issue and Device Compromise—All Issues Remediated"
++
++
++def get_resolved_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
++    """Use d4_verify_new_dns.py's inventory and verification logic to generate the resolved device list."""
++    resolved_devices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
++    for device in load_devices():
++        try:
++            is_resolved, _ = verify_dns(device)
++        except Exception as exc:
++            print(f"Could not verify {device['name']} ({device['address']}): {exc}")
++            continue
++
++        if is_resolved:
++            resolved_devices.append(device)
++    return resolved_devices
++
++
++def build_email(devices: list[dict[str, str]]) -> EmailMessage:
++    """Build one resolution email containing all successfully remediated devices."""
++    device_list = "\n".join(
++        f"- Hostname: {device['name']} | IP address: {device['address']}"
++        for device in devices
++    )
++    body = (
++        "Dear Stakeholders,\n\n"
++        "This is an automated notification to inform you that the DNS service issue and all related device compromises have been successfully resolved.\n\n"
++        "The following devices were affected and have now been remediated:\n\n"
++        f"{device_list}\n\n"
++        "No further action is required at this time. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the IT support team.\n\n"
++        "Thank you for your attention.\n\n"
++        "Best regards,\n"
++        "Network Monitoring System"
++    )
++    message = EmailMessage()
++    message["Subject"] = SUBJECT
++    message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
++    message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
++    message.set_content(body)
++    return message
++
++
++def send_resolution_emails(devices: list[dict[str, str]]) -> bool:
++    """Send a resolution email for the resolved devices and verify the SMTP server accepted it."""
++    if not devices:
++        print("No devices with resolved DNS settings were found; no emails sent.")
++        return True
++
++    all_sent = True
++    try:
++        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
++            server.ehlo()
++            print(f"Connected to email server {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT}")
++            message = build_email(devices)
++            refused = server.send_message(message)
++            accepted = not refused
++            status = "SUCCESS" if accepted else "FAILED"
++            print(
++                f"{status}: resolution email for {len(devices)} device(s) accepted by the email server"
++            )
++            all_sent = all_sent and accepted
++    except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
++        print(f"FAILED: could not connect to {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
++        return False
++    return all_sent
++
++
++def main() -> int:
++    devices = get_resolved_devices()
++    print(f"Found {len(devices)} device(s) with resolved DNS settings.")
++    return 0 if send_resolution_emails(devices) else 1
++
++

++    raise SystemExit(main())

++#!/usr/bin/env python3
++import time
++import requests
++
++GNS3_SERVER = "http://localhost:3080"
++PROJECT_ID = "980fb060-20d5-4268-8ba6-f215a2b4f9c3"
++
++SERVER_NODES = ["DNS1", "DNS2", "API", "DB", "SMTP", "SVR1", "SVR2"]
++ROUTER_NODE = "ROUTER1" # dhcp service
++SWITCH_NODES = ["SW1", "SW2", "SW3", "SW4"]
++DHCP_CLIENT_NODES = ["PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "WEBTERM"]
++
++DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START = 120  # seconds
++
++session = requests.Session()
++
++def get_nodes():
++    r = session.get(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes")
++    r.raise_for_status()
++    return r.json()
++
++def find_node_by_name(nodes, name):
++    for node in nodes:
++        if node["name"] == name:
++            return node
++    raise ValueError(f"Node not found: {name}")
++
++def start_node(node_id, node_name):
++    r = session.post(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes/{node_id}/start")
++    r.raise_for_status()
++    print(f"Started: {node_name}")
++
++def print_green(msg):
++    print(f"\033[92m{'\n' + msg}\033[0m")
++
++def main():
++    nodes = get_nodes()
++
++    print_green("Starting network switches...")
++    for name in SWITCH_NODES:
++        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
++        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
++
++    print_green("Starting server nodes...")
++    for name in SERVER_NODES:
++        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
++        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
++
++    print_green("Starting network router and dhcp...")
++    dhcp_node = find_node_by_name(nodes,ROUTER_NODE)
++    start_node(dhcp_node["node_id"], dhcp_node["name"])
++
++    interval = 5
++    remaining = DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START
++
++    print(f"Waiting {DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START} seconds for DHCP service to come up...")
++    while remaining > 0:
++        print(f"  ⏳ {remaining} seconds remaining...")
++        sleep_time = min(interval, remaining)
++        time.sleep(sleep_time)
++        remaining -= sleep_time
++
++    print("Done waiting for DHCP service.")
++
++    print_green("\nStarting DHCP clients...")
++    for name in DHCP_CLIENT_NODES:
++        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
++        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
++
++    print_green("GNS3 network startup complete.")
++
++if __name__ == "__main__":
++    main()

+def unique_ipv4_values(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    values = OrderedDict()
+    for match in re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", text):
+        try:
+            parsed = ipaddress.IPv4Address(match)
+        except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
+            continue
+        values[str(parsed)] = None
+    return list(values)

+def receive_console_output(console: socket.socket, pause_seconds: float = 0.4) -> str:
+    time.sleep(pause_seconds)
+    chunks: list[bytes] = []
+    while True:
+        try:
+            chunk = console.recv(4096)
+        except socket.timeout:
+            break
+        if not chunk:
+            break
+        chunks.append(chunk)
+    return b"".join(chunks).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

+def unique_ipv4_values(text: str) -> list[str]:
+	values = OrderedDict()
+	for match in re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", text):
+		try:
+			parsed = ipaddress.IPv4Address(match)
+		except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
+			continue
+		values[str(parsed)] = None
+	return list(values)
+
+
+def preferred_dns_servers(dns_values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+	non_loopback = [dns_value for dns_value in dns_values if not dns_value.startswith("127.")]
+	if non_loopback:
+		return non_loopback
+	return dns_values
+
+
+def receive_console_output(console: socket.socket, pause_seconds: float = 0.4) -> str:
+	time.sleep(pause_seconds)
+	chunks: list[bytes] = []
+	while True:
+		try:
+			chunk = console.recv(4096)
+		except socket.timeout:
+			break
+		if not chunk:
+			break
+		chunks.append(chunk)
+	return b"".join(chunks).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+
+
+def resolve_dhcp_ip(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
+	access_port = device.get("access_port", "")
+	if not access_port:
+		return "", "Missing access port for DHCP device"
+
+	try:
+		access_port_number = int(access_port)
+	except ValueError:
+		return "", f"Invalid access port: {access_port}"
+
+	try:
+		with socket.create_connection((CONSOLE_HOST, access_port_number), timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as console:
+			console.settimeout(0.5)
+			receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.2)
+			console.sendall(b"\n")
+			receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.2)
+			console.sendall(f"{DHCP_USERNAME}\n".encode())
+			receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.2)
+			console.sendall(f"{DHCP_PASSWORD}\n".encode())
+			receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.6)
+			console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
+			output = receive_console_output(console, pause_seconds=0.8)
+	except OSError as exc:
+		return "", str(exc)
+
+	for candidate in unique_ipv4_values(output):
+		if candidate.startswith("127."):
+			continue
+		return candidate, ""
+	return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
+
+
+def resolve_runtime_device(device: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
+	runtime_device = dict(device)
+	if runtime_device["address"].lower() != "dhcp":
+		return runtime_device
+
+	runtime_ip, error = resolve_dhcp_ip(runtime_device)
+	if not runtime_ip:
+		raise RuntimeError(
+			f"Could not resolve current IP for DHCP device {runtime_device['name']}: {error}"
+		)
+	runtime_device["address"] = runtime_ip
+	runtime_device["resolved_from_dhcp"] = "true"
+	return runtime_device
+

+def read_live_dns_settings(device: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
+	client = connect_ssh(device)
+	try:
+		_, stdout, _ = client.exec_command(
+			"sh -lc 'cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null; printf '\\n'; resolvectl dns 2>/dev/null; printf '\\n'; systemd-resolve --status 2>/dev/null'",
+			timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+		)
+		output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+		return preferred_dns_servers(unique_ipv4_values(output))
+	finally:
+		client.close()
+

+def verify_live_dns(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
+	dns_values = read_live_dns_settings(device)
+	return set(dns_values) == APPROVED_DNS, dns_values

+def api_request(method: str, path: str, payload: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> tuple[int, object]:
+    body = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+    request = Request(
+        f"{API_BASE}{path}",
+        data=body,
+        method=method,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
+            "Accept": "application/json",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
+            raw = response.read().decode("utf-8")
+            parsed = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
+            return response.status, parsed
+    except HTTPError as exc:
+        raw = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        try:
+            parsed_error = json.loads(raw)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            parsed_error = {"error": raw}
+        return exc.code, parsed_error
+    except URLError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Could not connect to Helpdesk API: {exc.reason}") from exc
+
+
+def create_dns_ticket(device: dict[str, str], detected_dns: str, expected_dns: str, timestamp: str) -> tuple[bool, int | None]:
+    payload: dict[str, object] = {
+        "title": f"DNS configuration alert: {device['name']} ({device['address']})",
+        "description": (
+            "DNS misconfiguration detected and alert email sent.\n\n"
+            f"Device Name: {device['name']}\n"
+            f"IP Address: {device['address']}\n"
+            f"Detected DNS Setting: {detected_dns}\n"
+            f"Expected DNS Setting: {expected_dns}\n"
+            f"Time Detected: {timestamp}"
+        ),
+        "priority": "medium",
+    }
+
+    try:
+        status, response = api_request("POST", "", payload)
+    except RuntimeError as exc:
+        print(f"TICKET API ERROR: {exc}")
+        print("Verification: ticket created = False")
+        return False, None
+
+    print(f"Ticket create HTTP status: {status}")
+    print("Ticket create response:")
+    print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
+
+    success = 200 <= status < 300 and isinstance(response, dict) and "id" in response
+    print(f"Verification: ticket created = {success}")
+    if not success:
+        return False, None
+    return True, int(response["id"])
+
+
+def close_dns_ticket(ticket_id: int, corrected_dns: str, timestamp: str) -> bool:
+    payloads = [
+        {"status": "closed", "resolution": f"DNS corrected to {corrected_dns} at {timestamp}"},
+        {"status": "resolved", "resolution": f"DNS corrected to {corrected_dns} at {timestamp}"},
+    ]
+    attempts = [
+        ("PATCH", f"/{ticket_id}"),
+        ("PUT", f"/{ticket_id}"),
+        ("POST", f"/{ticket_id}/close"),
+    ]
+
+    last_status = 0
+    last_response: object = {"error": "No close attempt made"}
+    for method, path in attempts:
+        for payload in payloads:
+            try:
+                status, response = api_request(method, path, payload)
+            except RuntimeError as exc:
+                print(f"TICKET API ERROR: {exc}")
+                print("Verification: ticket closed = False")
+                return False
+            last_status, last_response = status, response
+            if 200 <= status < 300:
+                print(f"Ticket close HTTP status: {status}")
+                print("Ticket close response:")
+                print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
+                print("Verification: ticket closed = True")
+                return True
+
+    print(f"Ticket close HTTP status: {last_status}")
+    print("Ticket close response:")
+    print(json.dumps(last_response, indent=2))
+    print("Verification: ticket closed = False")
+    return False
+

+def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
+	name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
+	return (
+		name.startswith("router")
+		or name.startswith("sw")
+		or "switch" in name
+		or name == "smtp"
+	)
+
+
+def get_csv_path() -> Path:
+	for candidate in CSV_CANDIDATES:
+		if candidate.exists():
+			return candidate
+	raise FileNotFoundError(
+		"Could not find network_device.csv or network_devices.csv in the script directory."
+	)
+
+
+def find_first_default_device() -> tuple[str, str]:
+	csv_path = get_csv_path()
+	with csv_path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
+		for row in csv.DictReader(csvfile):
+			device_name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+			ip_address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+			if should_exclude(device_name):
+				continue
+			if not ip_address or ip_address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
+				continue
+			return device_name, ip_address
+	raise ValueError("No eligible static-IP device found in inventory for default ticket creation.")
+
+
+def find_device_ip_by_name(device_name: str) -> str:
+	target = device_name.strip().lower()
+	csv_path = get_csv_path()
+	with csv_path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
+		for row in csv.DictReader(csvfile):
+			name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+			ip_address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+			if name.lower() != target:
+				continue
+			if not ip_address or ip_address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
+				raise ValueError(f"Device '{device_name}' does not have a usable static IP address.")
+			return ip_address
+	raise ValueError(f"Device '{device_name}' was not found in the inventory CSV.")
+

+"""Log successful DNS checks while DNS monitoring is running."""
+"""Run this script while t2_c4_1_monitor_dns.py is running to log successful DNS checks."""
+"""Start DNS monitoring first, then run this script to log successful DNS checks, in another terminal."""
+
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import importlib.util
+import ipaddress
+import re
+import socket
+import time
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+CSV_CANDIDATES = (
+	Path(__file__).with_name("network_device.csv"),
+	Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv"),
+)
+CONSOLE_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
+CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
+VNC_PORT_RANGE = range(5900, 6000)
+
+DHCP_USERNAME = "ubuntu"
+DHCP_PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
+
+LOG_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name("monitor_logs")
+
+
+def load_dns_module() -> Any:
+	file_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "d522-Task-1-revision" / "d4_verify_new_dns.py"
+	spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("d4_verify_new_dns", file_path)
+	if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+		raise FileNotFoundError("Could not load d4_verify_new_dns.py from d522-Task-1-revision")
+	module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+	spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+	return module
+
+
+DNS_FIXER = load_dns_module()
+DNS1 = DNS_FIXER.DNS1
+DNS2 = DNS_FIXER.DNS2
+APPROVED_DNS = {DNS1, DNS2}
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+	parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+		description="Log successful DNS checks with a configurable delay between monitoring passes."
+	)
+	parser.add_argument(
+		"--interval-seconds",
+		type=int,
+		default=15,
+		help="Delay between monitoring passes to avoid excessive logging (default: 15).",
+	)
+	parser.add_argument(
+		"--one-shot",
+		action="store_true",
+		help="Run one monitoring pass and exit.",
+	)
+	return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
+	name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
+	return name.startswith("router") or name.startswith("sw") or "switch" in name or name == "smtp"
+
+
+def get_csv_path() -> Path:
+	for candidate in CSV_CANDIDATES:
+		if candidate.exists():
+			return candidate
+	raise FileNotFoundError("Could not find network_device.csv or network_devices.csv in the script directory.")
+
+
+def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+	csv_file = get_csv_path()
+	with csv_file.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
+		reader = csv.DictReader(csvfile)
+		devices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+		for row in reader:
+			name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+			if should_exclude(name):
+				continue
+
+			address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+			if not address or address.lower() == "none":
+				continue
+
+			devices.append(
+				{
+					"name": name,
+					"address": address,
+					"access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
+					"os": (row.get("OS") or "").strip(),
+					"username": (row.get("Username") or DHCP_USERNAME).strip() or DHCP_USERNAME,
+					"password": (row.get("Password") or DHCP_PASSWORD).strip() or DHCP_PASSWORD,
+				}
+			)
+	return devices
+
+
+def resolve_dhcp_ip(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
+	access_port = device.get("access_port", "")
+	if not access_port:
+		return "", "Missing access port"
+
+	device_name = (device.get("name") or "").lower()
+	device_os = (device.get("os") or "").lower()
+	try:
+		access_port_int = int(access_port)
+	except ValueError:
+		return "", f"Invalid access port: {access_port}"
+
+	if (
+		access_port_int in VNC_PORT_RANGE
+		or "vnc" in device_name
+		or "webterm" in device_name
+		or "vnc" in device_os
+	):
+		return "", "Non-CLI console endpoint (VNC/Webterm)"
+
+	try:
+		with socket.create_connection((CONSOLE_HOST, access_port_int), timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as console:
+			console.settimeout(0.5)
+			output = b""
+
+			def receive() -> None:
+				nonlocal output
+				while True:
+					try:
+						output += console.recv(4096)
+					except socket.timeout:
+						return
+
+			receive()
+			console.sendall(b"\n")
+			time.sleep(0.2)
+			console.sendall(f"{DHCP_USERNAME}\n".encode())
+			time.sleep(0.2)
+			console.sendall(f"{DHCP_PASSWORD}\n".encode())
+			time.sleep(0.6)
+			console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
+			time.sleep(0.8)
+			receive()
+
+		text = output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+		matches = re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", text)
+		for candidate in reversed(matches):
+			try:
+				ipaddress.IPv4Address(candidate)
+			except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
+				continue
+			if not candidate.startswith("127."):
+				return candidate, ""
+		return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
+	except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+		return "", str(exc)
+
+
+def build_device_context(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
+	name = device["name"]
+	address = device["address"]
+	username = device.get("username") or DHCP_USERNAME
+	password = device.get("password") or DHCP_PASSWORD
+
+	if address.lower() == "dhcp":
+		current_ip, error = resolve_dhcp_ip(device)
+		if not current_ip:
+			return name, {"name": name, "address": "DHCP", "username": username, "password": password, "_error": error}
+		return name, {"name": name, "address": current_ip, "username": username, "password": password}
+
+	return name, {"name": name, "address": address, "username": username, "password": password}
+
+
+def canonical_dns(dns_values: list[str]) -> str:
+	if not dns_values:
+		return "None"
+	return ", ".join(sorted(set(dns_values)))
+
+
+def check_dns_for_device(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+	current_dns = DNS_FIXER.read_dns_settings(device)
+	if not current_dns:
+		return False, "None"
+
+	matches_internal = set(current_dns) == APPROVED_DNS
+	verified, _ = DNS_FIXER.verify_dns(device) if matches_internal else (False, current_dns)
+	return verified, canonical_dns(current_dns)
+
+
+def get_log_file_path() -> Path:
+	LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+	date_tag = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
+	return LOG_DIR / f"dns_success_log_{date_tag}.log"
+
+
+def write_success_log(log_file: Path, timestamp: str, hostname: str, ip_address: str, dns_setting: str) -> None:
+	line = (
+		f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {hostname} | IP address: {ip_address} | "
+		f"Status: SUCCESS | DNS: {dns_setting}\n"
+	)
+	with log_file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+		handle.write(line)
+
+
+def run_logging_loop(interval_seconds: int, one_shot: bool) -> None:
+	print("Starting DNS success logger. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
+	log_file = get_log_file_path()
+	print(f"Log folder ready: {LOG_DIR}")
+	print(f"Writing success checks to: {log_file}")
+	if one_shot:
+		print("One-shot mode enabled: script will run one pass and exit.")
+
+	try:
+		while True:
+			devices = load_devices()
+			for row in devices:
+				name, context = build_device_context(row)
+				timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+				ip_address = context["address"]
+
+				if context.get("_error"):
+					print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {name} | IP address: DHCP | Status: FAIL")
+					continue
+
+				ok, detected_dns = check_dns_for_device(context)
+				if ok:
+					print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {name} | IP address: {ip_address} | Status: SUCCESS")
+					write_success_log(log_file, timestamp, name, ip_address, detected_dns)
+				else:
+					print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {name} | IP address: {ip_address} | Status: FAIL")
+
+			if one_shot:
+				print("One-shot pass complete.")
+				break
+
+			time.sleep(interval_seconds)
+	except FileNotFoundError as exc:
+		print(f"ERROR: {exc}")
+	except KeyboardInterrupt:
+		print("DNS success logger stopped by user.")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+	args = parse_args()
+	interval = max(5, args.interval_seconds)
+	run_logging_loop(interval_seconds=interval, one_shot=args.one_shot)
+	return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+	raise SystemExit(main())

+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+import paramiko
+
+
+CSV_CANDIDATES = (
+	Path(__file__).with_name("network_device.csv"),
+	Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv"),
+)
+BREAK_BIN = Path(__file__).with_name("Test_DNS") / "break_dns.bin"
+FIX_BIN = Path(__file__).with_name("Test_DNS") / "fix_dns.bin"
+
+SMTP_HOST = "smtp.d522.wgu.internal"
+SMTP_PORT = 1025
+SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+FROM_ADDRESS = "network-monitoring@localdomain"
+TO_ADDRESS = "stakeholders@localdomain"
+
+API_HOST = "api.d522.wgu.internal"
+API_PORT = 5000
+API_TOKEN = "vGkbXkGLqQSo7YLflp9DutuG8st4xdPPF7wnTcwB0FE"

+SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 15
+DHCP_USERNAME = "ubuntu"

+
+def load_dns_module() -> Any:
+	file_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "d522-Task-1-revision" / "d4_verify_new_dns.py"
+	spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("d4_verify_new_dns", file_path)
+	if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+		raise FileNotFoundError("Could not load d4_verify_new_dns.py from d522-Task-1-revision")
+	module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+	spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+	return module
+
+
+DNS_FIXER = load_dns_module()
+DNS1 = DNS_FIXER.DNS1
+DNS2 = DNS_FIXER.DNS2
+APPROVED_DNS = {DNS1, DNS2}
+
+
+def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
+	name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
+	return name.startswith("router") or name.startswith("sw") or "switch" in name or name == "smtp"
+
+
+def get_csv_path() -> Path:
+	for candidate in CSV_CANDIDATES:
+		if candidate.exists():
+			return candidate
+	raise FileNotFoundError("Could not find network_device.csv or network_devices.csv in the script directory.")
+
+
+def find_device(device_name: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+	csv_file = get_csv_path()
+	target = device_name.strip().lower()
+	with csv_file.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
+		for row in csv.DictReader(csvfile):
+			name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+			if should_exclude(name):
+				continue
+			if name.strip().lower() != target:
+				continue
+
+			address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+			if not address or address.lower() == "none":
+				raise ValueError(f"Device {name} does not have a usable address.")
+
+			return {
+				"name": name,
+				"address": address,
+				"access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
+				"username": (row.get("Username") or DHCP_USERNAME).strip() or DHCP_USERNAME,
+				"password": (row.get("Password") or DHCP_PASSWORD).strip() or DHCP_PASSWORD,
+			}
+
+	raise ValueError(f"Device '{device_name}' was not found in inventory or is excluded.")
+
+
+def canonical_dns(dns_values: list[str]) -> str:
+	if not dns_values:
+		return "None"
+	return ", ".join(sorted(set(dns_values)))
+
+
+def connect_ssh(device: dict[str, str]) -> paramiko.SSHClient:
+	client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+	client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+	client.connect(
+		hostname=device["address"],
+		username=device["username"],
+		password=device["password"],
+		timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+		banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+		auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+	)
+	return client
+
+
+def run_remote_sudo(client: paramiko.SSHClient, password: str, command: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
+	stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
+		f"sudo -S -p '' sh -c {json.dumps(command)}",
+		get_pty=True,
+		timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+	)
+	stdin.write(f"{password}\n")
+	stdin.flush()
+	out = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+	err = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+	code = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
+	return code, out, err
+
+
+def run_dns_binary(device: dict[str, str], binary_path: Path) -> bool:
+	if not binary_path.exists():
+		raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required file not found: {binary_path}")
+
+	remote_path = f"/tmp/{binary_path.name}"
+	client = connect_ssh(device)
+	try:
+		sftp = client.open_sftp()
+		try:
+			sftp.put(str(binary_path), remote_path)
+		finally:
+			sftp.close()
+
+		code, out, err = run_remote_sudo(
+			client,
+			device["password"],
+			f"chmod +x {remote_path} && {remote_path}",
+		)
+		print(f"Executed {binary_path.name} on {device['name']} ({device['address']}) with exit code {code}")
+		if out:
+			print(out)
+		if err:
+			print(err)
+		return code == 0
+	finally:
+		client.close()
+
+
+def force_break_dns_fallback(device: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
+	"""Fallback only when break_dns.bin does not produce a mismatch in this lab run."""
+	client = connect_ssh(device)
+	try:
+		command = "printf '%s\\n' 'nameserver 1.1.1.1' 'nameserver 8.8.8.8' > /etc/resolv.conf"
+		code, out, err = run_remote_sudo(client, device["password"], command)
+		print(f"Fallback DNS break command exit code: {code}")
+		if out:
+			print(out)
+		if err:
+			print(err)
+		return code == 0
+	finally:
+		client.close()
+
+
+def force_fix_dns_fallback(device: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
+	"""Fallback only when fix_dns.bin does not restore approved DNS settings."""
+	client = connect_ssh(device)
+	try:
+		command = (
+			f"printf '%s\\n' 'nameserver {DNS1}' 'nameserver {DNS2}' "
+			"'options timeout:2 attempts:2' > /etc/resolv.conf"
+		)
+		code, out, err = run_remote_sudo(client, device["password"], command)
+		print(f"Fallback DNS fix command exit code: {code}")
+		if out:
+			print(out)
+		if err:
+			print(err)
+		return code == 0
+	finally:
+		client.close()
+
+
+def send_email(subject: str, body: str) -> bool:
+	message = EmailMessage()
+	message["Subject"] = subject
+	message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
+	message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
+	message.set_content(body)
+
+	try:
+		with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
+			code, banner = server.ehlo()
+			print(f"SMTP EHLO response: {code} {banner.decode(errors='replace')}")
+			failures = server.send_message(message)
+			if failures:
+				print("SMTP send failures:")
+				print(json.dumps(failures, indent=2))
+				return False
+		print(f"SMTP verification: Email accepted for subject '{subject}'")
+		return True
+	except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
+		print(f"SMTP ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+		return False
+
+
+def api_request(method: str, path: str, payload: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> tuple[int, object]:
+	body = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+	request = Request(
+		f"{API_BASE}{path}",
+		data=body,
+		method=method,
+		headers={
+			"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
+			"Accept": "application/json",
+			"Content-Type": "application/json",
+		},
+	)
+
+	try:
+		with urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
+			raw = response.read().decode("utf-8")
+			parsed = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
+			return response.status, parsed
+	except HTTPError as exc:
+		raw = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+		try:
+			parsed_error = json.loads(raw)
+		except json.JSONDecodeError:
+			parsed_error = {"error": raw}
+		return exc.code, parsed_error
+	except URLError as exc:
+		raise RuntimeError(f"Could not connect to Helpdesk API: {exc.reason}") from exc
+
+
+def create_dns_ticket(device: dict[str, str], detected_dns: str, expected_dns: str, timestamp: str) -> tuple[bool, int, object]:
+	payload: dict[str, object] = {
+		"title": f"DNS configuration alert: {device['name']} ({device['address']})",
+		"description": (
+			"DNS misconfiguration detected and alert email sent.\n\n"
+			f"Device Name: {device['name']}\n"
+			f"IP Address: {device['address']}\n"
+			f"Detected DNS Setting: {detected_dns}\n"
+			f"Expected DNS Setting: {expected_dns}\n"
+			f"Time Detected: {timestamp}"
+		),
+		"priority": "medium",
+	}
+	status, response = api_request("POST", "", payload)
+	success = 200 <= status < 300 and isinstance(response, dict) and "id" in response
+	return success, status, response
+
+
+def close_dns_ticket(ticket_id: int, corrected_dns: str, timestamp: str) -> tuple[bool, int, object]:
+	payloads = [
+		{"status": "closed", "resolution": f"DNS corrected to {corrected_dns} at {timestamp}"},
+		{"status": "resolved", "resolution": f"DNS corrected to {corrected_dns} at {timestamp}"},
+	]
+	attempts = [
+		("PATCH", f"/{ticket_id}"),
+		("PUT", f"/{ticket_id}"),
+		("POST", f"/{ticket_id}/close"),
+	]
+
+	last_status = 0
+	last_response: object = {"error": "No close attempt made"}
+	for method, path in attempts:
+		for payload in payloads:
+			status, response = api_request(method, path, payload)
+			last_status, last_response = status, response
+			if 200 <= status < 300:
+				return True, status, response
+	return False, last_status, last_response
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+	parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+		description="Break DNS, send alert email and ticket, fix DNS, then send resolved email and close ticket."
+	)
+	parser.add_argument("--device-name", default="DB", help="Target device from network_devices.csv")
+	return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def main() -> int:

+	print("Ticket create response:")
+	print(json.dumps(create_response, indent=2))

+		if not ok:
+			print("ERROR: DNS is still not corrected after fallback fix.", file=sys.stderr)
+			return 1
+
+	subject_fixed = f"DNS Configuration Restored: {device['name']} ({device['address']})"
+	body_fixed = (
+		"Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"

+		f"Device Name: {device['name']}\n"
+		f"IP Address: {device['address']}\n"
+		f"Corrected DNS Setting: {expected_dns}\n"
+		f"Time Corrected: {timestamp_fixed}\n\n"
+		"No further action is required at this time.\n\n"
+		"Best regards,\n"
+		"Network Monitoring System"
+	)
+
+	print("Step 5/6: Send DNS correction email")
+	fixed_email_ok = send_email(subject_fixed, body_fixed)
+	print(f"Verification: correction email sent = {fixed_email_ok}")
+	if not fixed_email_ok:
+		return 1
+
+	print("Step 6/6: Close Helpdesk ticket")
+	closed, close_status, close_response = close_dns_ticket(ticket_id, final_dns, timestamp_fixed)
+	print(f"Ticket close HTTP status: {close_status}")
+	print("Ticket close response:")
+	print(json.dumps(close_response, indent=2))
+	print(f"Verification: ticket closed = {closed}")
+
+	return 0 if closed else 1
+

+if __name__ == "__main__":
+	raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Send a network-unavailable SMTP email and create a Helpdesk API ticket."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import smtplib
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime
+from email.message import EmailMessage
+from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+
+SMTP_HOST = "smtp.d522.wgu.internal"
+SMTP_PORT = 1025
+SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+FROM_ADDRESS = "network-monitoring@localdomain"
+TO_ADDRESS = "network-administrator@localdomain"
+
+API_HOST = "api.d522.wgu.internal"
+API_PORT = 5000
+API_PATH = "/api/tickets"
+API_TOKEN = "vGkbXkGLqQSo7YLflp9DutuG8st4xdPPF7wnTcwB0FE"
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+	parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+		description=(
+			"Generate the network-unavailable email, send it to SMTP, "
+			"and create a Helpdesk ticket when accepted."
+		)
+	)
+	parser.add_argument("--device-name", required=True, help="Unavailable device name")
+	parser.add_argument("--ip-address", required=True, help="Unavailable device IP address")
+	parser.add_argument(
+		"--priority",
+		default="medium",
+		choices=("low", "medium", "high"),
+		help="Helpdesk ticket priority",
+	)
+	return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def build_email_message(device_name: str, ip_address: str, timestamp: str) -> EmailMessage:
+	message = EmailMessage()
+	message["Subject"] = f"Network Device Unavailable: {device_name} ({ip_address})"
+	message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
+	message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
+	message.set_content(
+		"Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"
+		"This is an automated notification that the following network device is currently unavailable:\n\n"
+		f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+		f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+		f"Last Checked: {timestamp}\n\n"
+		"Please investigate this issue at your earliest convenience.\n\n"
+		"Best regards,\n"
+		"Network Monitoring System"
+	)
+	return message
+
+
+def send_network_alert_email(device_name: str, ip_address: str, timestamp: str) -> bool:
+	message = build_email_message(device_name, ip_address, timestamp)
+	try:
+		with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
+			code, banner = server.ehlo()
+			print(f"SMTP EHLO response: {code} {banner.decode(errors='replace')}")
+			send_failures = server.send_message(message)
+			if send_failures:
+				print("SMTP send failures:")
+				print(json.dumps(send_failures, indent=2))
+				return False
+			print(
+				"SMTP verification: Email accepted by "
+				f"{SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT} for subject '{message['Subject']}'"
+			)
+			return True
+	except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
+		print(f"SMTP ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+		return False
+
+
+def api_request(payload: dict[str, object]) -> tuple[int, object]:
+	url = f"http://{API_HOST}:{API_PORT}{API_PATH}"
+	request = Request(
+		url,
+		data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+		method="POST",
+		headers={
+			"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
+			"Accept": "application/json",
+			"Content-Type": "application/json",
+		},
+	)
+
+	try:
+		with urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
+			body = response.read().decode("utf-8")
+			parsed = json.loads(body) if body else {}
+			return response.status, parsed
+	except HTTPError as exc:
+		error_body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+		try:
+			parsed_error = json.loads(error_body)
+		except json.JSONDecodeError:
+			parsed_error = {"error": error_body}
+		return exc.code, parsed_error
+	except URLError as exc:
+		raise RuntimeError(f"Could not connect to Helpdesk API: {exc.reason}") from exc
+
+
+def create_ticket(device_name: str, ip_address: str, timestamp: str, priority: str) -> tuple[int, object]:
+	payload: dict[str, object] = {
+		"title": f"Network Device Unavailable: {device_name} ({ip_address})",
+		"description": (
+			"Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"
+			"This is an automated notification that the following network device is currently unavailable:\n\n"
+			f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+			f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+			f"Last Checked: {timestamp}\n\n"
+			"Please investigate this issue at your earliest convenience.\n\n"
+			"Best regards,\n"
+			"Network Monitoring System"
+		),
+		"priority": priority,
+	}
+	return api_request(payload)
+
+
+def submit_network_unavailable_incident(
+	device_name: str,
+	ip_address: str,
+	priority: str = "medium",
+	timestamp: str | None = None,
+) -> bool:
+	"""Send outage email first, then create a helpdesk ticket and print verification output."""
+	timestamp_value = timestamp or datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+
+	print("Step 1/2: Sending network-unavailable email to SMTP server...")
+	email_sent = send_network_alert_email(device_name, ip_address, timestamp_value)
+	if not email_sent:
+		print("Verification failed: Email was not accepted by SMTP server.")
+		return False
+
+	print("Step 2/2: Creating Helpdesk API ticket after SMTP verification...")
+	try:
+		status_code, response = create_ticket(
+			device_name,
+			ip_address,
+			timestamp_value,
+			priority,
+		)
+	except RuntimeError as exc:
+		print(f"API ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+		return False
+
+	success = 200 <= status_code < 300 and isinstance(response, dict) and "id" in response
+	print(f"Ticket API HTTP status: {status_code}")
+	print("Ticket API response:")
+	print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
+
+	if success:
+		print("Verification passed: Ticket was created successfully.")
+		return True
+
+	print("Verification failed: Ticket was not created successfully.")
+	return False
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+	args = parse_args()
+	success = submit_network_unavailable_incident(
+		args.device_name,
+		args.ip_address,
+		priority=args.priority,
+	)
+	return 0 if success else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+	raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/t2_c3_test_ping.py b/t2_c3_test_ping.py

+"""Continuously verify DNS settings for monitored devices, fix misconfigurations, and alert on failures."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import csv
+import importlib.util
+import ipaddress
+import os
+import re
+import shlex
+import smtplib
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import time
+from datetime import datetime
+from email.message import EmailMessage
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+CSV_CANDIDATES = (
+    Path(__file__).with_name("network_device.csv"),
+    Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv"),
+)
+PING_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30
+CONSOLE_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
+CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
+VNC_PORT_RANGE = range(5900, 6000)
+
+DHCP_USERNAME = "ubuntu"
+DHCP_PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
+SMTP_HOST = os.getenv("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.d522.wgu.internal")
+SMTP_PORT = int(os.getenv("SMTP_PORT", "1025"))
+SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+FROM_ADDRESS = os.getenv("DNS_ALERT_FROM", "network-monitoring@localdomain")
+TO_ADDRESS = os.getenv("DNS_ALERT_TO", "stakeholders@localdomain")
+
+
+def load_dns_module() -> Any:
+    file_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "d522-Task-1-revision" / "d4_verify_new_dns.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("d4_verify_new_dns", file_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise FileNotFoundError("Could not load d4_verify_new_dns.py from d522-Task-1-revision")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+DNS_FIXER = load_dns_module()
+DNS1 = DNS_FIXER.DNS1
+DNS2 = DNS_FIXER.DNS2
+APPROVED_DNS = {DNS1, DNS2}
+
+
+def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
+    name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
+    return name.startswith("router") or name.startswith("sw") or "switch" in name or name == "smtp"
+
+
+def get_csv_path() -> Path:
+    for candidate in CSV_CANDIDATES:
+        if candidate.exists():
+            return candidate
+    raise FileNotFoundError("Could not find network_device.csv or network_devices.csv in the script directory.")
+
+
+def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    csv_file = get_csv_path()
+    with csv_file.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
+        reader = csv.DictReader(csvfile)
+        devices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+        for row in reader:
+            device_name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+            if should_exclude(device_name):
+                continue
+
+            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+            if not address or address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
+                continue
+
+            devices.append(
+                {
+                    "name": device_name,
+                    "address": address,
+                    "access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
+                    "os": (row.get("OS") or "").strip(),
+                    "username": (row.get("Username") or DHCP_USERNAME).strip() or DHCP_USERNAME,
+                    "password": (row.get("Password") or DHCP_PASSWORD).strip() or DHCP_PASSWORD,
+                }
+            )
+    return devices
+
+
+def resolve_dhcp_ip(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    access_port = device.get("access_port", "")
+    if not access_port:
+        return "", "Missing access port"
+
+    device_name = (device.get("name") or "").lower()
+    device_os = (device.get("os") or "").lower()
+    try:
+        access_port_int = int(access_port)
+    except ValueError:
+        return "", f"Invalid access port: {access_port}"
+
+    if (
+        access_port_int in VNC_PORT_RANGE
+        or "vnc" in device_name
+        or "webterm" in device_name
+        or "vnc" in device_os
+    ):
+        return "", "Non-CLI console endpoint (VNC/Webterm)"
+
+    try:
+        with socket.create_connection((CONSOLE_HOST, access_port_int), timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as console:
+            console.settimeout(0.5)
+            output = b""
+
+            def receive() -> None:
+                nonlocal output
+                while True:
+                    try:
+                        output += console.recv(4096)
+                    except socket.timeout:
+                        return
+
+            receive()
+            console.sendall(b"\n")
+            time.sleep(0.2)
+            console.sendall(f"{DHCP_USERNAME}\n".encode())
+            time.sleep(0.2)
+            console.sendall(f"{DHCP_PASSWORD}\n".encode())
+            time.sleep(0.6)
+            console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
+            time.sleep(0.8)
+            receive()
+
+        text = output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", text)
+        for candidate in reversed(matches):
+            try:
+                ipaddress.IPv4Address(candidate)
+            except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
+                continue
+            if not candidate.startswith("127."):
+                return candidate, ""
+        return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        return "", str(exc)
+
+
+def build_device_context(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
+    name = device["name"]
+    address = device["address"]
+    username = device.get("username") or DHCP_USERNAME
+    password = device.get("password") or DHCP_PASSWORD
+
+    if address.lower() == "dhcp":
+        current_ip, error = resolve_dhcp_ip(device)
+        if not current_ip:
+            return name, {"name": name, "address": "DHCP", "username": username, "password": password, "_error": error}
+        return name, {"name": name, "address": current_ip, "username": username, "password": password}
+
+    return name, {"name": name, "address": address, "username": username, "password": password}
+
+
+def send_dns_email(device_name: str, ip_address: str, detected_dns: str, expected_dns: str, timestamp: str) -> bool:
+    message = EmailMessage()
+    message["Subject"] = f"DNS Configuration Alert: {device_name} ({ip_address})"
+    message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
+    message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
+    message.set_content(
+        "Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"
+        "This is an automated alert that the DNS configuration for the following device has been altered from the expected settings:\n\n"
+        f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+        f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+        f"Detected DNS Setting: {detected_dns}\n"
+        f"Expected DNS Setting: {expected_dns}\n"
+        f"Time Detected: {timestamp}\n\n"
+        "The system will attempt to automatically correct this configuration.\n\n"
+        "Best regards,\n"
+        "Network Monitoring System"
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
+            server.ehlo()
+            server.send_message(message)
+        return True
+    except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
+        print(f"EMAIL FAILED: {device_name} ({ip_address}) - {exc}")
+        return False
+
+
+def check_dns_for_device(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bool, str, str, str]:
+    """Return success flag, current_dns, expected_dns, and reason for a device."""
+    name = device["name"]
+    ip_address = device["address"]
+    device_for_dns = {
+        "name": name,
+        "address": ip_address,
+        "username": device.get("username") or DHCP_USERNAME,
+        "password": device.get("password") or DHCP_PASSWORD,
+    }
+
+    current_dns = DNS_FIXER.read_dns_settings(device_for_dns)
+    expected_dns = ", ".join(sorted(APPROVED_DNS))
+
+    if current_dns and set(current_dns) == APPROVED_DNS:
+        ok, _ = DNS_FIXER.verify_dns(device_for_dns)
+        if ok:
+            return True, ", ".join(current_dns), expected_dns, ""
+        return False, ", ".join(current_dns), expected_dns, "DNS verification failed"
+
+    if not current_dns:
+        return False, "None", expected_dns, "No DNS server configured"
+
+    return False, ", ".join(current_dns), expected_dns, "DNS does not match approved internal DNS"
+
+
+def monitor_dns_configuration() -> None:
+    print("Starting DNS monitoring loop. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
+    open_alerts: set[str] = set()
+    try:
+        while True:
+            devices = load_devices()
+            for row in devices:
+                name, context = build_device_context(row)
+                timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+                ip_address = context["address"]
+
+                if context.get("_error"):
+                    status = "FAIL"
+                    print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {name} | IP address: DHCP | Status: {status}")
+                    if name not in open_alerts:
+                        email_ok = send_dns_email(name, "DHCP", "Unknown", ", ".join(sorted(APPROVED_DNS)), timestamp)
+                        if email_ok:
+                            open_alerts.add(name)
+                            print(f"ALERT SENT: {name} DHCP resolution failed. DNS check skipped.")
+                    continue
+
+                ok, detected_dns, expected_dns, reason = check_dns_for_device(context)
+                status = "SUCCESS" if ok else "FAIL"
+                print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {name} | IP address: {ip_address} | Status: {status}")
+
+                if ok:
+                    open_alerts.discard(name)
+                    continue
+
+                if name not in open_alerts:
+                    send_dns_email(name, ip_address, detected_dns, expected_dns, timestamp)
+                    open_alerts.add(name)
+                    print(f"ALERT SENT: {name} DNS configuration alert emailed to administrator")
+                    print(f"Detected DNS: {detected_dns}")
+                    print(f"Expected DNS: {expected_dns}")
+                    print(f"Reason: {reason}")
+                    # Attempt to automatically correct the misconfiguration using the provided helper.
+                    try:
+                        corrected = DNS_FIXER.set_internal_dns(context)
+                        if corrected:
+                            print(f"AUTO-CORRECT: {name} DNS settings corrected.")
+                            verified, _, _, _ = check_dns_for_device(context)
+                            print(f"VERIFY: {name} status after correction = {'SUCCESS' if verified else 'FAIL'}")
+                    except Exception as exc:
+                        print(f"AUTO-CORRECT FAILED: {name} - {exc}")
+                else:
+                    print(f"ALERT SKIPPED: {name} already has an open DNS misconfiguration alert")
+
+            time.sleep(PING_INTERVAL_SECONDS)
+    except KeyboardInterrupt:
+        print("DNS monitoring stopped by user.")
+    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
+        print(f"ERROR: {exc}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    monitor_dns_configuration()

+"""Create a Helpdesk API ticket for an unavailable network device."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+
+API_HOSTS = [
+	"api.d522.wgu.internal",
+	"helpdesk.d522.wgu.internal",
+]
+API_PORT = 5000
+TICKETS_PATH = "/api/tickets"
+API_TOKEN = "vGkbXkGLqQSo7YLflp9DutuG8st4xdPPF7wnTcwB0FE"
+
+
+def api_url_for(host: str) -> str:
+	return f"http://{host}:{API_PORT}{TICKETS_PATH}"
+
+
+def api_request(method: str, payload: dict | None = None, host: str = API_HOSTS[0]) -> tuple[int, object]:
+	"""Send an authenticated API request and return the HTTP status and JSON body."""
+	url = api_url_for(host)
+	body = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+	request = Request(
+		url,
+		data=body,
+		method=method,
+		headers={
+			"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
+			"Accept": "application/json",
+			"Content-Type": "application/json",
+		},
+	)
+
+	try:
+		with urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
+			response_body = response.read().decode("utf-8")
+			return response.status, json.loads(response_body) if response_body else {}
+	except HTTPError as exc:
+		error_body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+		try:
+			details = json.loads(error_body)
+		except json.JSONDecodeError:
+			details = {"error": error_body}
+		return exc.code, details
+	except URLError as exc:
+		raise RuntimeError(f"Could not connect to {url}: {exc.reason}") from exc
+
+
+def create_ticket(device_name: str, ip_address: str, reason: str, host: str = API_HOSTS[0]) -> tuple[int, object]:
+	"""Create one helpdesk ticket for an unavailable device."""
+	checked_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+	payload = {
+		"title": f"Network Device Unavailable: {device_name} ({ip_address})",
+		"description": (
+			"Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"
+			"This is an automated notification that the following network device is currently unavailable:\n\n"
+			f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+			f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+			f"Last Checked: {checked_at}\n"
+			f"Failure Reason: {reason}\n\n"
+			"Please investigate this issue at your earliest convenience.\n\n"
+			"Best regards,\n"
+			"Network Monitoring System"
+		),
+		"priority": "medium",
+	}
+	return api_request("POST", payload, host=host)
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+	parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+		description="Create a Helpdesk ticket for an unavailable network device."
+	)
+	parser.add_argument("--device-name", required=True, help="Hostname of the unavailable device")
+	parser.add_argument("--ip-address", required=True, help="Current IP address of the device")
+	parser.add_argument("--reason", required=True, help="Reason the device is unavailable")
+	parser.add_argument(
+		"--host",
+		choices=API_HOSTS,
+		default=API_HOSTS[0],
+		help="Helpdesk API host to send the ticket to",
+	)
+	return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+	try:
+		args = parse_args()
+		status, response = create_ticket(args.device_name, args.ip_address, args.reason, host=args.host)
+		success = 200 <= status < 300 and isinstance(response, dict) and "id" in response
+		result = "SUCCESS" if success else "FAILED"
+		print(f"{result}: HTTP {status}")
+		print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
+		return 0 if success else 1
+	except (RuntimeError, OSError) as exc:
+		print(f"ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+		return 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+	raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Continuously monitor devices with ICMP and send email alerts on failures."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import csv
+import ipaddress
+import os
+import re
+import smtplib
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import time
+from datetime import datetime
+from email.message import EmailMessage
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+CSV_CANDIDATES = (
+	Path(__file__).with_name("network_device.csv"),
+	Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv"),
+)
+
+PING_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30
+CONSOLE_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
+CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
+VNC_PORT_RANGE = range(5900, 6000)
+
+DHCP_USERNAME = "ubuntu"
+DHCP_PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
+
+SMTP_HOST = os.getenv("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.d522.wgu.internal")
+SMTP_PORT = int(os.getenv("SMTP_PORT", "1025"))
+SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+FROM_ADDRESS = os.getenv("ALERT_FROM", "network-monitoring@localdomain")
+TO_ADDRESS = os.getenv("ALERT_TO", "stakeholders@localdomain")
+
+
+def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
+	name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
+	return (
+		name.startswith("router")
+		or name.startswith("sw")
+		or "switch" in name
+		or name == "smtp"
+	)
+
+
+def get_csv_path() -> Path:
+	for candidate in CSV_CANDIDATES:
+		if candidate.exists():
+			return candidate
+	raise FileNotFoundError(
+		"Could not find network_device.csv or network_devices.csv in the script directory."
+	)
+
+
+def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+	"""Load monitorable devices from CSV, including DHCP clients."""
+	csv_file = get_csv_path()
+	with csv_file.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
+		reader = csv.DictReader(csvfile)
+		devices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+		for row in reader:
+			device_name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+			if should_exclude(device_name):
+				continue
+
+			address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+			if not address or address.lower() == "none":
+				continue
+
+			devices.append(
+				{
+					"name": device_name,
+					"address": address,
+					"access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
+					"os": (row.get("OS") or "").strip(),
+				}
+			)
+	return devices
+
+
+def extract_valid_ipv4s(text: str) -> list[str]:
+	matches = re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", text)
+	valid: list[str] = []
+	for ip in matches:
+		try:
+			ipaddress.IPv4Address(ip)
+		except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
+			continue
+		valid.append(ip)
+	return valid
+
+
+def extract_tagged_ip(output_text: str, tag: str) -> str:
+	pattern = rf"{re.escape(tag)}=([0-9.]+)"
+	match = re.search(pattern, output_text)
+	if not match:
+		return ""
+	ip = match.group(1)
+	try:
+		ipaddress.IPv4Address(ip)
+		return ip
+	except ipaddress.AddressValueError:
+		return ""
+
+
+def discover_dhcp_address(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
+	"""Resolve current DHCP address by connecting to the device console."""
+	access_port = device.get("access_port", "")
+	if not access_port:
+		return "", "Missing access port"
+
+	device_name = (device.get("name") or "").lower()
+	device_os = (device.get("os") or "").lower()
+	try:
+		access_port_int = int(access_port)
+	except ValueError:
+		return "", f"Invalid access port: {access_port}"
+
+	if (
+		access_port_int in VNC_PORT_RANGE
+		or "vnc" in device_name
+		or "webterm" in device_name
+		or "vnc" in device_os
+	):
+		return "", "Non-CLI console endpoint (VNC/Webterm)"
+
+	try:
+		with socket.create_connection(
+			(CONSOLE_HOST, access_port_int),
+			timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+		) as console:
+			console.settimeout(0.5)
+			output = b""
+
+			def receive() -> None:
+				nonlocal output
+				while True:
+					try:
+						output += console.recv(4096)
+					except socket.timeout:
+						return
+
+			receive()
+			console.sendall(b"\n")
+			time.sleep(0.2)
+			console.sendall(f"{DHCP_USERNAME}\n".encode())
+			time.sleep(0.2)
+			console.sendall(f"{DHCP_PASSWORD}\n".encode())
+			time.sleep(0.8)
+			console.sendall(
+				b"echo DHCP_PRIMARY_IP=$(ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.* src \\([0-9.]*\\).*/\\1/p' | head -n1)\n"
+			)
+			time.sleep(0.5)
+			console.sendall(b"echo DHCP_ALL_IPS=$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null)\n")
+			time.sleep(0.6)
+			receive()
+
+		output_text = output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+		primary_ip = extract_tagged_ip(output_text, "DHCP_PRIMARY_IP")
+		if primary_ip and not primary_ip.startswith("127."):
+			return primary_ip, ""
+
+		hostname_line_match = re.search(r"DHCP_ALL_IPS=([^\r\n]*)", output_text)
+		if hostname_line_match:
+			addresses = extract_valid_ipv4s(hostname_line_match.group(1))
+		else:
+			addresses = extract_valid_ipv4s(output_text)
+
+		non_loopback = [ip for ip in addresses if not ip.startswith("127.")]
+		if non_loopback:
+			return non_loopback[-1], ""
+		return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
+	except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+		return "", str(exc)
+
+
+def ping_host(ip_address: str) -> bool:
+	result = subprocess.run(
+		["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", ip_address],
+		capture_output=True,
+		text=True,
+		check=False,
+	)
+	return result.returncode == 0
+
+
+def send_failure_email(device_name: str, ip_address: str, reason: str, timestamp: str) -> bool:
+	message = EmailMessage()
+	message["Subject"] = f"Network Device Unavailable: {device_name} ({ip_address})"
+	message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
+	message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
+	message.set_content(
+		"Dear Network Administrator,\n\n"
+		"This is an automated notification that the following network device is currently unavailable:\n\n"
+		f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+		f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+		f"Last Checked: {timestamp}\n\n"
+		"Please investigate this issue at your earliest convenience.\n\n"
+		"Best regards,\n"
+		"Network Monitoring System\n"
+	)
+
+	try:
+		with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
+			server.ehlo()
+			server.send_message(message)
+		return True
+	except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
+		print(f"EMAIL FAILED: {device_name} ({ip_address}) - {exc}")
+		return False
+
+
+def monitor_devices() -> None:
+	print("Starting ICMP monitoring loop. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
+	try:
+		while True:
+			devices = load_devices()
+
+			for device in devices:
+				name = device["name"]
+				configured_address = device["address"]
+				timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+
+				ip_address = configured_address
+				reason = ""
+				if configured_address.lower() == "dhcp":
+					ip_address, reason = discover_dhcp_address(device)
+					if not ip_address:
+						status = "FAIL"
+						print(f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {name} | IP address: DHCP | Status: {status}")
+						email_ok = send_failure_email(name, "DHCP", reason, timestamp)
+						if email_ok:
+							print(f"ALERT SENT: {name} DHCP resolution failure email accepted by SMTP")
+						continue
+
+				try:
+					success = ping_host(ip_address)
+				except FileNotFoundError:
+					print("ERROR: ping command not available on this system.")
+					return
+
+				status = "SUCCESS" if success else "FAIL"
+				print(
+					f"{timestamp} | Hostname: {name} | IP address: {ip_address} | Status: {status}"
+				)
+
+				if not success:
+					email_ok = send_failure_email(name, ip_address, "ICMP request timed out or host unreachable", timestamp)
+					if email_ok:
+						print(f"ALERT SENT: {name} failure email accepted by SMTP")
+
+			time.sleep(PING_INTERVAL_SECONDS)
+	except FileNotFoundError as exc:
+		print(f"ERROR: {exc}")
+		return
+	except KeyboardInterrupt:
+		print("Monitoring stopped by user.")
+		return
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+	monitor_devices()
+

+			addresses = extract_valid_ipv4s(hostname_line_match.group(1))
+		else:
+			addresses = extract_valid_ipv4s(output_text)
+
+		non_loopback = [ip for ip in addresses if not ip.startswith("127.")]
+		if non_loopback:
+			return non_loopback[-1], ""
+		return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
+	except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+		return "", str(exc)
+
+
+def ping_host(ip_address: str) -> bool:
+	try:
+		result = subprocess.run(
+			["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", ip_address],
+			capture_output=True,
+			text=True,
+			check=False,
+		)
+		return result.returncode == 0
+	except FileNotFoundError:
+		print("ping command not available on this system.")
+		return False
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+	try:
+		devices = get_devices()
+	except FileNotFoundError as exc:
+		print(f"ERROR: {exc}")
+		return
+
+	for device in devices:
+		name = device["name"]
+		address = device["address"]
+
+		if address.lower() == "dhcp":
+			address, error = discover_dhcp_address(device)
+			if not address:
+				print(f"FAILED: {name} current DHCP address unavailable ({error})")
+				continue
+			print(f"{name} current DHCP address: {address}")
+
+		print(f"Pinging {name} ({address})...")
+		if ping_host(address):
+			print(f"SUCCESS: {name} reachable at {address}")
+		else:
+			print(f"FAILED: {name} unreachable at {address}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+	main()
