+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Create DNS backup folders and export the DNS1/DNS2 configuration files."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import paramiko
+
+
+USERNAME = "ubuntu"
+PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
+
+
+def get_csv_path() -> Path:
+    """Resolve the device inventory CSV path, supporting csv/cvs variants."""
+    workspace_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    candidates = [
+        workspace_root / "network_devices.csv",
+        workspace_root / "network_devices.cvs",
+    ]
+
+    for candidate in candidates:
+        if candidate.exists():
+            return candidate
+
+    raise FileNotFoundError(
+        "No inventory file was found. Expected one of: network_devices.csv, network_devices.cvs"
+    )
+
+
+def get_dns_servers(csv_path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Return the DNS1 and DNS2 devices and their IP addresses from the CSV."""
+    dns_servers: dict[str, str] = {}
+
+    with csv_path.open("r", newline="") as csvfile:
+        reader = csv.DictReader(csvfile)
+        for row in reader:
+            device_name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+            if device_name not in {"DNS1", "DNS2"}:
+                continue
+
+            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+            if address and address not in {"DHCP", "None"}:
+                dns_servers[device_name] = address
+
+    return dns_servers
+
+
+def create_backup_structure(base_dir: Path, dns_servers: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, Path]:
+    """Create the parent directory and per-server folders for DNS backups."""
+    base_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+    server_paths: dict[str, Path] = {}
+    for device_name, ip_address in dns_servers.items():
+        folder = base_dir / f"Server [{ip_address}]"
+        folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+        server_paths[device_name] = folder
+
+    return server_paths
+
+
+def fetch_dns_config(server_ip: str, username: str = USERNAME, password: str = PASSWORD) -> str:
+    """Connect to a DNS server and export its configuration content."""
+    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+
+    try:
+        client.connect(
+            hostname=server_ip,
+            username=username,
+            password=password,
+            timeout=10,
+            banner_timeout=10,
+            auth_timeout=10,
+        )
+
+        command = (
+            "sudo -S -p '' bash -lc '\n"
+            "for file in /etc/bind/named.conf /etc/bind/named.conf.options /etc/bind/named.conf.local /etc/bind/named.conf.default-zones; do\n"
+            "  if [ -f \"$file\" ]; then\n"
+            "    echo \"===== $file =====\";\n"
+            "    cat \"$file\";\n"
+            "    echo;\n"
+            "  fi;\n"
+            "done;\n"
+            "if [ ! -f /etc/bind/named.conf ] && [ -f /etc/named.conf ]; then\n"
+            "  echo \"===== /etc/named.conf =====\";\n"
+            "  cat /etc/named.conf;\n"
+            "fi;\n"
+            "if [ ! -f /etc/bind/named.conf ] && [ ! -f /etc/named.conf ]; then\n"
+            "  echo \"No DNS config file was found on the server.\";\n"
+            "fi\n'"
+        )
+
+        stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(command, timeout=20)
+        stdin.write(f"{password}\n")
+        stdin.flush()
+
+        config_output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+        error_output = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+
+        if config_output:
+            return config_output
+        if error_output:
+            return error_output
+        return "No DNS configuration output was returned."
+    finally:
+        client.close()
+
+
+def write_backup_file(target_dir: Path, server_name: str, server_ip: str) -> None:
+    """Write a record-config.txt file for a single DNS server."""
+    config_text = fetch_dns_config(server_ip)
+    backup_file = target_dir / "record-config.txt"
+    backup_file.write_text(
+        f"DNS Server Backup\n"
+        f"Server Name: {server_name}\n"
+        f"Server IP: {server_ip}\n"
+        f"Generated from: {server_ip}\n\n"
+        f"{config_text}\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Create the DNS backup folders and save configuration backups for the DNS servers."""
+    csv_file = get_csv_path()
+    backup_root = csv_file.parent / "DNS Backup"
+
+    dns_servers = get_dns_servers(csv_file)
+    if not dns_servers:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"No DNS1/DNS2 records were found in {csv_file}.")
+
+    backup_locations = create_backup_structure(backup_root, dns_servers)
+
+    for server_name, ip_address in dns_servers.items():
+        folder = backup_locations[server_name]
+        write_backup_file(folder, server_name, ip_address)
+        print(f"Created backup for {server_name} at {folder / 'record-config.txt'}")
+
+    print(f"\nDNS Backup directory ready: {backup_root}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Ping inventory devices, including DHCP clients discovered through GNS3."""
+
+import csv
+import re
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+CSV_FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
+USERNAME = "ubuntu"
+PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
+CONSOLE_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
+CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
+
+
+def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
+    name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
+    return (
+        name.startswith("router")
+        or name.startswith("sw")
+        or "switch" in name
+        or name == "smtp"
+    )
+
+
+def get_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Return eligible devices, including entries whose address is DHCP."""
+    with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
+        reader = csv.DictReader(csvfile)
+        devices = []
+        for row in reader:
+            device_name = row.get("Device Name", "")
+            if should_exclude(device_name):
+                continue
+
+            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+            if not address or address.lower() == "none":
+                continue
+
+            devices.append(
+                {
+                    "name": device_name.strip(),
+                    "address": address,
+                    "access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
+                }
+            )
+    return devices
+
+
+def discover_dhcp_address(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Use the GNS3 console and Ubuntu credentials to find a DHCP address."""
+    try:
+        with socket.create_connection(
+            (CONSOLE_HOST, int(device["access_port"])),
+            timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        ) as console:
+            console.settimeout(0.5)
+            output = b""
+
+            def receive() -> None:
+                nonlocal output
+                while True:
+                    try:
+                        output += console.recv(4096)
+                    except socket.timeout:
+                        return
+
+            receive()
+            console.sendall(f"{USERNAME}\n".encode())
+            time.sleep(0.2)
+            console.sendall(f"{PASSWORD}\n".encode())
+            time.sleep(0.5)
+            console.sendall(b"hostname -I\n")
+            time.sleep(0.5)
+            receive()
+
+        addresses = re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", output.decode(
+            "utf-8", errors="replace"
+        ))
+        if addresses:
+            return addresses[-1], ""
+        return "", "No IPv4 address found in console output"
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        return "", str(exc)
+
+
+def ping_host(ip_address: str) -> bool:
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            ["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", ip_address],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            check=False,
+        )
+        return result.returncode == 0
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        print("ping command not available on this system.")
+        return False
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    for device in get_devices():
+        name = device["name"]
+        address = device["address"]
+
+        if address.lower() == "dhcp":
+            address, error = discover_dhcp_address(device)
+            if not address:
+                print(f"FAILED: {name} current DHCP address unavailable ({error})")
+                continue
+            print(f"{name} current DHCP address: {address}")
+
+        print(f"Pinging {name} ({address})...")
+        if ping_host(address):
+            print(f"SUCCESS: {name} reachable at {address}")
+        else:
+            print(f"FAILED: {name} unreachable at {address}")

+"""Print connectivity and DNS settings for devices in the inventory CSV."""
+
+import csv
+import re
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import paramiko
+
+
+CSV_FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
+ICMP_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("b1_icmp.py")
+PING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 1
+SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
+
+
+def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+	"""Load all devices from the inventory file."""
+	with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csv_file:
+		return [
+			{
+				"name": (row.get("Device Name") or "Unknown").strip(),
+				"address": (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip(),
+				"access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
+				"os": (row.get("OS") or "").strip(),
+				"username": (row.get("Username") or "").strip(),
+				"password": (row.get("Password") or "").strip(),
+			}
+			for row in csv.DictReader(csv_file)
+		]
+
+
+def run_icmp_script() -> str:
+	"""Run b1_icmp.py and return its standard output and errors."""
+	result = subprocess.run(
+		[sys.executable, str(ICMP_SCRIPT)],
+		capture_output=True,
+		text=True,
+		check=False,
+		cwd=str(ICMP_SCRIPT.parent),
+	)
+	return result.stdout + result.stderr
+
+
+def parse_icmp_output(output: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+	"""Extract addresses from successful fixed and DHCP ping results."""
+	addresses = {
+		match.group("name"): match.group("address")
+		for match in re.finditer(
+			r"^SUCCESS: (?P<name>[^ ]+) reachable at (?P<address>\S+)$",
+			output,
+			re.MULTILINE,
+		)
+	}
+	addresses.update(
+		{
+			match.group("name"): match.group("address")
+			for match in re.finditer(
+				r"^(?P<name>[^\s]+) current DHCP address: (?P<address>\S+)$",
+				output,
+				re.MULTILINE,
+			)
+		}
+	)
+	return addresses
+
+
+def run_console_command(device: dict[str, str], command: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+	"""Run a command through the device's local GNS3 console."""
+	try:
+		with socket.create_connection(
+			("127.0.0.1", int(device["access_port"])), timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
+		) as console:
+			console.settimeout(0.5)
+			output = b""
+			try:
+				while True:
+					output += console.recv(4096)
+			except (socket.timeout, ConnectionResetError):
+				pass
+
+			console.sendall(f"{device['username']}\n".encode())
+			time.sleep(0.2)
+			console.sendall(f"{device['password']}\n".encode())
+			time.sleep(0.5)
+			console.sendall(f"{command}\n".encode())
+			time.sleep(0.5)
+			while True:
+				try:
+					output += console.recv(4096)
+				except socket.timeout:
+					break
+
+		return output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), ""
+	except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+		return "", str(exc)
+
+
+def get_dhcp_details(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, list[str], str]:
+	"""Discover a DHCP address and DNS settings through the GNS3 console."""
+	output, error = run_console_command(
+		device,
+		"hostname -I; cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns 2>/dev/null",
+	)
+	first_line = output.splitlines()[0] if output.splitlines() else ""
+	address_match = re.search(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", first_line)
+	address = address_match.group(0) if address_match else ""
+	servers = re.findall(
+		r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE
+	)
+	return address, servers, error
+
+
+def ping_device(address: str) -> tuple[bool | None, str]:
+	"""Return the ping result and a reason when the address cannot be checked."""
+	if not address or address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
+		return None, "No fixed IP address"
+
+	try:
+		result = subprocess.run(
+			["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", str(PING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS), address],
+			capture_output=True,
+			text=True,
+			check=False,
+		)
+	except FileNotFoundError:
+		return None, "ping command is unavailable"
+
+	return result.returncode == 0, ""
+
+
+def dns_command(device_os: str) -> str:
+	"""Return the DNS command appropriate for the device operating system."""
+	if device_os.lower() == "vyos":
+		return "show system name-server"
+	return "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns 2>/dev/null"
+
+
+def read_dns_settings(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+	"""Read DNS server entries over SSH and return entries plus an error message."""
+	client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+	client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+	try:
+		client.connect(
+			hostname=device["address"],
+			username=device["username"],
+			password=device["password"],
+			timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+			banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+			auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+		)
+		_, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
+			dns_command(device["os"]), timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
+		)
+		output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+		error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+		servers = re.findall(
+			r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE
+		)
+		if not servers and device["os"].lower() == "vyos":
+			servers = re.findall(r"(?:name-server|nameserver)\s+(\S+)", output)
+		return servers, error
+	except Exception as exc:
+		return [], str(exc)
+	finally:
+		client.close()
+
+
+def print_device_status(device: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+	"""Print connectivity and DNS information for one inventory entry."""
+	name = device["name"]
+	is_dhcp = device["address"].lower() == "dhcp"
+	dns_servers: list[str] = []
+	dns_error = ""
+	if is_dhcp:
+		address, dns_servers, dns_error = get_dhcp_details(device)
+		if not address:
+			address = "Unknown"
+	else:
+		address = device["address"] or "N/A"
+
+	reachable, reason = ping_device(address if address != "Unknown" else "")
+
+	if reachable is True:
+		connectivity = "ONLINE"
+		if not is_dhcp:
+			dns_servers, dns_error = read_dns_settings(device)
+		dns_status = ", ".join(dns_servers) if dns_servers else "Unavailable"
+		if dns_error:
+			dns_status += f" ({dns_error})"
+	elif reachable is False:
+		connectivity = "OFFLINE"
+		dns_status = ", ".join(dns_servers) if dns_servers else "Unavailable"
+	else:
+		connectivity = f"NOT CHECKED ({reason})"
+		dns_status = ", ".join(dns_servers) if dns_servers else "Unavailable"
+		if dns_error:
+			dns_status += f" ({dns_error})"
+
+	print(f"{name} ({address})")
+	print(f"  Connectivity: {connectivity}")
+	print(f"  DNS settings: {dns_status}")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+	"""Print status for every device in network_devices.csv."""
+	devices = {device["name"]: device for device in load_devices()}
+	addresses = parse_icmp_output(run_icmp_script())
+	if not addresses:
+		print("No reachable devices were reported by b1_icmp.py.")
+		return
+
+	for name, address in addresses.items():
+		device = devices.get(name)
+		if device is None:
+			continue
+		device["address"] = address
+		servers, error = read_dns_settings(device)
+		print(f"{name} ({address})")
+		print(f"  DNS settings: {', '.join(servers) if servers else 'Unavailable'}")
+		if error:
+			print(f"  SSH error: {error}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+	main()

+# Creating a script to list devices whose DNS connection is not working properly.
+
+import csv
+import re
+import socket
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import paramiko
+
+
+CSV_FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
+APPROVED_DNS = {"10.10.10.10", "10.10.10.20"}
+USERNAME = "ubuntu"
+PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
+SSH_TIMEOUT = 10
+CONSOLE_TIMEOUT = 5
+
+
+def should_exclude(device_name: str) -> bool:
+    name = (device_name or "").strip().lower()
+    return (
+        name.startswith("router")
+        or name.startswith("sw")
+        or "switch" in name
+        or name == "smtp"
+    )
+
+
+def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    devices = []
+    with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csv_file:
+        reader = csv.DictReader(csv_file)
+        for row in reader:
+            name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+            if should_exclude(name):
+                continue
+
+            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+            if not address or address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
+                continue
+
+            devices.append(
+                {
+                    "name": name,
+                    "address": address,
+                    "access_port": (row.get("Access Port") or "").strip(),
+                    "username": (row.get("Username") or USERNAME).strip(),
+                    "password": (row.get("Password") or PASSWORD).strip(),
+                }
+            )
+    return devices
+
+
+def run_console_command(device: dict[str, str], command: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    try:
+        with socket.create_connection(
+            ("127.0.0.1", int(device["access_port"])),
+            timeout=CONSOLE_TIMEOUT,
+        ) as console:
+            console.settimeout(0.5)
+            output = b""
+            try:
+                while True:
+                    output += console.recv(4096)
+            except (socket.timeout, ConnectionResetError):
+                pass
+
+            console.sendall(f"{device['username']}\n".encode())
+            time.sleep(0.2)
+            console.sendall(f"{device['password']}\n".encode())
+            time.sleep(0.5)
+            console.sendall(f"{command}\n".encode())
+            time.sleep(0.5)
+            while True:
+                try:
+                    output += console.recv(4096)
+                except socket.timeout:
+                    break
+            return output.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), ""
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        return "", str(exc)
+
+
+def get_dns_servers_from_device(device: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
+    if device["address"].lower() == "dhcp":
+        output, _ = run_console_command(device, "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns")
+        return re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE)
+
+    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+    try:
+        client.connect(
+            hostname=device["address"],
+            username=device["username"],
+            password=device["password"],
+            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
+            banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
+            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
+        )
+        _, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
+            "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns",
+            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
+        )
+        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        return re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, flags=re.MULTILINE)
+    except Exception:
+        return []
+    finally:
+        client.close()
+
+
+def dns_connection_ok(device: dict[str, str], dns_servers: list[str]) -> bool:
+    if not dns_servers:
+        return False
+
+    for dns_server in dns_servers:
+        if device["address"].lower() == "dhcp":
+            output, _ = run_console_command(
+                device,
+                f'ping -c 1 -W 1 "{dns_server}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo FAIL',
+            )
+            if "FAIL" in output:
+                return False
+        else:
+            client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+            client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+            try:
+                client.connect(
+                    hostname=device["address"],
+                    username=device["username"],
+                    password=device["password"],
+                    timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
+                    banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
+                    auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
+                )
+                _, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
+                    f'ping -c 1 -W 1 "{dns_server}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo FAIL',
+                    timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT,
+                )
+                output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+                if "FAIL" in output:
+                    return False
+            finally:
+                client.close()
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    bad_devices = []
+    for device in load_devices():
+        servers = get_dns_servers_from_device(device)
+        configured_ok = set(servers) == APPROVED_DNS
+        connected_ok = dns_connection_ok(device, servers)
+        if not configured_ok or not connected_ok:
+            bad_devices.append({
+                "name": device["name"],
+                "address": device["address"],
+                "dns": servers,
+                "status": "OFFLINE" if not connected_ok else "MISCONFIGURED",
+            })
+
+    if not bad_devices:
+        print("No devices are failing DNS connectivity.")
+    else:
+        print("Devices with DNS connection issues:")
+        for entry in bad_devices:
+            dns_value = entry["dns"][0] if entry["dns"] else "None"
+            print(f"Device name: {entry['name']}")
+            print(f"IP address of DNS: {dns_value}")
+            print(f"Status: {entry['status']}")
+            print()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+""" Created a script to send email alerts to stakeholders when DNS connectivity issues are detected. """
+
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+
+API_HOST = "api.d522.wgu.internal"
+API_PORT = 5000
+API_PATH = "/api/tickets"
+API_TOKEN = "vGkbXkGLqQSo7YLflp9DutuG8st4xdPPF7wnTcwB0FE"
+API_URL = f"http://{API_HOST}:{API_PORT}{API_PATH}"
+SMTP_FALLBACK_HOST = os.getenv("SMTP_HOST", "api.d522.wgu.internal")
+SMTP_FALLBACK_PORT = int(os.getenv("SMTP_PORT", "5000"))
+DNS_STATUS_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("b2_dns_status.py")
+
+
+def run_dns_status() -> str:
+    """Run b2_dns_status.py and return its full output."""
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(DNS_STATUS_SCRIPT)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+        cwd=str(DNS_STATUS_SCRIPT.parent),
+    )
+    return result.stdout + result.stderr
+
+
+def parse_bad_devices(output: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Parse the DNS status script output into device/email alerts."""
+    pattern = re.compile(
+        r"Device name:\s*(?P<device>.+?)\s*\n"
+        r"IP address of DNS:\s*(?P<dns>.+?)\s*\n"
+        r"Status:\s*(?P<status>.+?)(?:\n\n|$)",
+        re.DOTALL,
+    )
+
+    devices = []
+    for match in pattern.finditer(output):
+        device_name = match.group("device").strip()
+        dns_ip = match.group("dns").strip()
+        status = match.group("status").strip()
+        if device_name and dns_ip and status:
+            devices.append(
+                {
+                    "device_name": device_name,
+                    "dns_ip": dns_ip,
+                    "status": status,
+                }
+            )
+    return devices
+
+
+def build_email_body(device: dict[str, str]) -> str:
+    """Build the stakeholder email body for one device."""
+    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+    return (
+        "Dear Stakeholders,\n\n"
+        "This is an automated alert from the DNS monitoring service.\n\n"
+        f"Device name: {device['device_name']}\n"
+        f"IP address of DNS: {device['dns_ip']}\n"
+        f"Status: {device['status']}\n"
+        f"Last checked: {timestamp}\n\n"
+        "Please investigate and remediate the reported DNS issue as soon as possible.\n\n"
+        "Regards,\n"
+        "Network Monitoring Team"
+    )
+
+
+def api_request(method: str, payload: dict | None = None) -> tuple[int, object]:
+    """Send a request to the mail/helpdesk API using the bearer token."""
+    body = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+    request = Request(
+        API_URL,
+        data=body,
+        method=method,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
+            "Accept": "application/json",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
+            response_body = response.read().decode("utf-8")
+            return response.status, json.loads(response_body) if response_body else {}
+    except HTTPError as exc:
+        error_body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        try:
+            return exc.code, json.loads(error_body)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            return exc.code, {"error": error_body}
+    except URLError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Could not reach {API_URL}: {exc.reason}") from exc
+
+
+def send_alert_email(device: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    """Send a notification through the HTTP API with bearer token auth."""
+    email_body = build_email_body(device)
+    payload = {
+        "title": f"DNS connection issue: {device['device_name']}",
+        "description": email_body,
+        "priority": "medium",
+        "metadata": {
+            "device_name": device['device_name'],
+            "dns_ip": device['dns_ip'],
+            "status": device['status'],
+            "type": "dns_alert",
+        },
+    }
+
+    status, response = api_request("POST", payload)
+    if 200 <= status < 300:
+        print(f"Email/API alert created for {device['device_name']} (status={status})")
+        print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
+    else:
+        print(f"Failed to create alert for {device['device_name']}: HTTP {status}")
+        print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    output = run_dns_status()
+    alerts = parse_bad_devices(output)
+
+    if not alerts:
+        print("No devices were reported as failing DNS connectivity.")
+        raise SystemExit(0)
+
+    for alert in alerts:
+        send_alert_email(alert)

+"""Generate and send urgent compromise emails for failing DNS devices."""
+"""Verify that the SMTP server accepted the email for each device."""
+
+import re
+import smtplib
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime
+from email.message import EmailMessage
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+SMTP_HOST = "smtp.d522.wgu.internal"
+SMTP_PORT = 1025
+FROM_ADDR = "network-monitoring@localdomain"
+TO_ADDR = "stakeholders@localdomain"
+SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+
+
+def run_dns_status() -> str:
+    """Run the DNS validation script and return its full output."""
+    script = Path(__file__).with_name("b2_dns_status.py")
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(script)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+        cwd=str(script.parent),
+    )
+    return result.stdout + result.stderr
+
+
+def parse_problem_devices(output: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Extract the device name, DNS IP, and status from the DNS status output."""
+    pattern = re.compile(
+        r"Device name:\s*(?P<device>.+?)\s*\n"
+        r"IP address of DNS:\s*(?P<dns>.+?)\s*\n"
+        r"Status:\s*(?P<status>.+?)(?:\n\n|$)",
+        re.DOTALL,
+    )
+
+    devices = []
+    for match in pattern.finditer(output):
+        device_name = match.group("device").strip()
+        dns_ip = match.group("dns").strip()
+        status = match.group("status").strip()
+        if device_name and dns_ip:
+            devices.append(
+                {
+                    "device_name": device_name,
+                    "ip_address": dns_ip,
+                    "status": status,
+                }
+            )
+    return devices
+
+
+def build_email_message(device_name: str, ip_address: str, timestamp: str) -> EmailMessage:
+    """Build the urgent compromise email based on the required template."""
+    body = (
+        "Dear Stakeholders,\n\n"
+        "This is an automated alert to inform you that the following device(s) have been identified as compromised during the recent network scan:\n\n"
+        f"Device Name: {device_name}\n"
+        f"IP Address: {ip_address}\n"
+        f"Last Checked: {timestamp}\n\n"
+        "Immediate investigation and remediation are recommended to prevent further impact.\n\n"
+        "If you have any questions or require additional information, please contact the IT support team.\n\n"
+        "Best regards,  \n"
+        "Network Monitoring System  \n\n"
+        "Resolution Notification Email"
+    )
+
+    message = EmailMessage()
+    message["Subject"] = "URGENT: Device Compromise Detected—Immediate Attention Required"
+    message["From"] = FROM_ADDR
+    message["To"] = TO_ADDR
+    message.set_content(body)
+    return message
+
+
+def send_email(device_name: str, ip_address: str) -> None:
+    """Send the urgent email to the SMTP server and verify the server accepted it."""
+    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+    message = build_email_message(device_name, ip_address, timestamp)
+
+    try:
+        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
+            server.ehlo()
+            server.send_message(message)
+            print(f"Email sent to SMTP server inbox for {device_name} ({ip_address})")
+            print(f"Verified: SMTP server accepted the email for {device_name} ({ip_address})")
+    except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
+        print(f"Could not send email for {device_name} ({ip_address}) to {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT}: {exc}")
+        raise
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    output = run_dns_status()
+    devices = parse_problem_devices(output)
+
+    if not devices:
+        print("No compromised devices were reported by b2_dns_status.py.")
+        return 0
+
+    for device in devices:
+        send_email(device["device_name"], device["ip_address"])
+
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Create Helpdesk API tickets for DNS alerts and print the API responses."""
+
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+
+API_HOSTS = [
+    "api.d522.wgu.internal",
+    "helpdesk.d522.wgu.internal",
+]
+API_PORT = 5000
+TICKETS_PATH = "/api/tickets"
+API_TOKEN = "vGkbXkGLqQSo7YLflp9DutuG8st4xdPPF7wnTcwB0FE"
+DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("b2_dns_status.py")
+
+
+def api_url_for(host: str) -> str:
+    return f"http://{host}:{API_PORT}{TICKETS_PATH}"
+
+
+def api_request(method: str, payload: dict | None = None, host: str = API_HOSTS[0]) -> tuple[int, object]:
+    """Send a Bearer-token authenticated request and return its HTTP status and JSON body."""
+    url = api_url_for(host)
+    body = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+    request = Request(
+        url,
+        data=body,
+        method=method,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
+            "Accept": "application/json",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
+            response_body = response.read().decode("utf-8")
+            return response.status, json.loads(response_body) if response_body else {}
+    except HTTPError as exc:
+        error_body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        try:
+            details = json.loads(error_body)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            details = {"error": error_body}
+        return exc.code, details
+    except URLError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Could not connect to {url}: {exc.reason}") from exc
+
+
+def verify_api_access() -> str:
+    """Verify access with a harmless test ticket and return the working host."""
+    last_error = None
+    for host in API_HOSTS:
+        try:
+            status, response = api_request(
+                "POST",
+                {
+                    "title": "Helpdesk API connectivity test",
+                    "description": "Test ticket created by c2_alerts_script.py to verify Helpdesk API access.",
+                    "priority": "medium",
+                },
+                host=host,
+            )
+            print(f"API connectivity test: host={host} HTTP {status}")
+            print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
+            if 200 <= status < 300 and isinstance(response, dict) and "id" in response:
+                return host
+            last_error = response
+        except RuntimeError as exc:
+            last_error = str(exc)
+            print(f"Host {host} failed: {exc}")
+    raise RuntimeError(f"Helpdesk API connectivity test was not successful. Last error: {last_error}")
+
+
+def run_dns_check() -> str:
+    """Run b2_dns_status.py and return the full output."""
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+        cwd=str(DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT.parent),
+    )
+    return result.stdout + result.stderr
+
+
+def parse_alert_devices(output: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Extract the devices reported by b2_dns_status.py as failing DNS connectivity."""
+    pattern = re.compile(
+        r"Device name:\s*(?P<device>.+?)\s*\n"
+        r"IP address of DNS:\s*(?P<dns>.+?)\s*\n"
+        r"Status:\s*(?P<status>.+?)(?:\n\n|$)",
+        re.DOTALL,
+    )
+    devices = []
+    for match in pattern.finditer(output):
+        device_name = match.group("device").strip()
+        dns_ip = match.group("dns").strip()
+        status = match.group("status").strip()
+        if device_name and dns_ip and status:
+            devices.append(
+                {
+                    "device_name": device_name,
+                    "dns_ip": dns_ip,
+                    "status": status,
+                }
+            )
+    return devices
+
+
+def create_alert_ticket(device: dict[str, str], host: str) -> tuple[int, object]:
+    """Create one Helpdesk ticket for a device alert."""
+    checked_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+    payload = {
+        "title": f"DNS connection issue: {device['device_name']}",
+        "description": (
+            "The device has a DNS connectivity or DNS configuration issue.\n\n"
+            f"Device: {device['device_name']}\n"
+            f"DNS IP: {device['dns_ip']}\n"
+            f"Status: {device['status']}\n"
+            f"Checked at: {checked_at}"
+        ),
+        "priority": "medium",
+    }
+    return api_request("POST", payload, host=host)
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    try:
+        host = verify_api_access()
+        output = run_dns_check()
+        devices = parse_alert_devices(output)
+        if not devices:
+            print("No devices were reported as failing DNS connectivity; no alert tickets were created.")
+            return 0
+
+        all_successful = True
+        for device in devices:
+            status, response = create_alert_ticket(device, host)
+            successful = 200 <= status < 300 and isinstance(response, dict) and "id" in response
+            all_successful = all_successful and successful
+            result = "SUCCESS" if successful else "FAILED"
+            print(f"\n{result}: {device['device_name']} ({device['dns_ip']}) - HTTP {status}")
+            print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
+        return 0 if all_successful else 1
+    except (RuntimeError, OSError) as exc:
+        print(f"ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Connect to the internal DNS servers and print each service status separately."""
+
+import paramiko
+
+
+DNS_SERVERS = [
+	{
+		"name": "DNS1",
+		"address": "10.10.10.10",
+		"hostname": "ns1.d522.wgu.internal",
+		"username": "ubuntu",
+		"password": "ubuntu",
+	},
+	{
+		"name": "DNS2",
+		"address": "10.10.10.20",
+		"hostname": "ns2.d522.wgu.internal",
+		"username": "ubuntu",
+		"password": "ubuntu",
+	},
+]
+
+SSH_PORT = 22
+SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+
+# Ubuntu commonly uses bind9; the fallback also supports systems using named.
+STATUS_COMMAND = (
+	"hostname; "
+	"if systemctl list-unit-files bind9.service 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^bind9.service'; then "
+	"systemctl is-active bind9; systemctl --no-pager --full status bind9; "
+	"elif systemctl list-unit-files named.service 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^named.service'; then "
+	"systemctl is-active named; systemctl --no-pager --full status named; "
+	"else echo 'No bind9.service or named.service unit was found.'; fi"
+)
+
+
+def get_dns_status(server: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
+	"""Connect to one server and return its hostname, stdout, and stderr."""
+	client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+	client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+
+	try:
+		client.connect(
+			hostname=server["address"],
+			port=SSH_PORT,
+			username=server["username"],
+			password=server["password"],
+			timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+			banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+			auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+		)
+		_, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(STATUS_COMMAND, timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
+		return (
+			stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip(),
+			stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip(),
+		)
+	finally:
+		client.close()
+
+
+def print_server_status(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
+	"""Print one server's result and return whether SSH/status retrieval succeeded."""
+	print(f"\n{'=' * 60}\n{server['name']} - {server['hostname']} ({server['address']})\n{'=' * 60}")
+	try:
+		stdout, stderr = get_dns_status(server)
+		print(stdout or "No status output was returned.")
+		if stderr:
+			print(f"\nCommand errors:\n{stderr}")
+		return bool(stdout)
+	except Exception as exc:
+		print(f"Connection/status check failed: {exc}")
+		return False
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+	results = [print_server_status(server) for server in DNS_SERVERS]
+	raise SystemExit(0 if all(results) else 1)

+"""Restart a stopped internal DNS service and verify both DNS servers."""
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import shlex
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import paramiko
+
+
+DNS_SERVERS = [
+	{
+		"name": "DNS1",
+		"address": "10.10.10.10",
+		"hostname": "ns1.d522.wgu.internal",
+		"username": "ubuntu",
+		"password": "ubuntu",
+	},
+	{
+		"name": "DNS2",
+		"address": "10.10.10.20",
+		"hostname": "ns2.d522.wgu.internal",
+		"username": "ubuntu",
+		"password": "ubuntu",
+	},
+]
+
+SSH_PORT = 22
+SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+VERIFY_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("d1_connect_dns.py")
+
+# Detect either service name, restart it only when it is not active, and
+# return the resulting state. sudo -S supports the supplied Ubuntu password.
+RESTART_COMMAND = """
+if systemctl list-unit-files bind9.service 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^bind9.service'; then
+    service=bind9
+elif systemctl list-unit-files named.service 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^named.service'; then
+    service=named
+else
+    echo 'No bind9.service or named.service unit was found.'
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+state=$(systemctl is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)
+echo "Service: $service"
+echo "Before restart: $state"
+if [ "$state" != "active" ]; then
+    echo "Restart services"
+    printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASSWORD" | sudo -S -p '' systemctl restart "$service"
+    state=$(systemctl is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)
+fi
+echo "After restart: $state"
+[ "$state" = "active" ]
+"""
+
+
+def restart_if_down(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
+	"""Restart the server's DNS service when down and return its final state."""
+	client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+	client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+
+	try:
+		client.connect(
+			hostname=server["address"],
+			port=SSH_PORT,
+			username=server["username"],
+			password=server["password"],
+			timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+			banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+			auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+		)
+		command = f"export SUDO_PASSWORD={shlex.quote(server['password'])}\n{RESTART_COMMAND}"
+		_, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(command, timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
+		output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+		error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+		print(output or "No restart output was returned.")
+		if error:
+			print(f"Command errors:\n{error}")
+		return stdout.channel.recv_exit_status() == 0
+	finally:
+		client.close()
+
+
+def verify_restart() -> int:
+	"""Rerun d1_connect_dns.py and print its separate DNS server results."""
+	if not VERIFY_SCRIPT.exists():
+		print("\nVerification script not found")
+		return 1
+	result = subprocess.run(
+		[sys.executable, str(VERIFY_SCRIPT)],
+		capture_output=True,
+		text=True,
+		check=False,
+		cwd=str(VERIFY_SCRIPT.parent),
+	)
+	print("\n===== DNS restart verification =====")
+	print(result.stdout.strip())
+	if result.stderr.strip():
+		print(f"\nVerification errors:\n{result.stderr.strip()}")
+	if result.returncode == 0:
+		print("\nServices restored successfully")
+	return result.returncode
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+	all_restarts_succeeded = True
+	for server in DNS_SERVERS:
+		print(f"\n{'=' * 60}\n{server['name']} - {server['hostname']} ({server['address']})\n{'=' * 60}")
+		try:
+			if not restart_if_down(server):
+				all_restarts_succeeded = False
+		except Exception as exc:
+			all_restarts_succeeded = False
+			print(f"Connection/restart failed: {exc}")
+
+	verification_status = verify_restart()
+	return 0 if all_restarts_succeeded and verification_status == 0 else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+	raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Correct compromised DNS settings and verify the resulting configuration."""
+
+import re
+import shlex
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import paramiko
+
+
+DNS1 = "10.10.10.10"
+DNS2 = "10.10.10.20"
+USERNAME = "ubuntu"
+PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
+SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("d4_verify_dns_settings.py")
+
+
+def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Load non-infrastructure devices from the inventory CSV."""
+    csv_file = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
+    devices = []
+    with csv_file.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        import csv
+
+        for row in csv.DictReader(handle):
+            name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip().lower()
+            if not address or address in {"dhcp", "none"}:
+                continue
+            if name.lower().startswith("router") or name.lower().startswith("sw") or "switch" in name.lower() or name.lower() == "smtp":
+                continue
+            devices.append(
+                {
+                    "name": name,
+                    "address": address,
+                    "username": (row.get("Username") or USERNAME).strip() or USERNAME,
+                    "password": (row.get("Password") or PASSWORD).strip() or PASSWORD,
+                }
+            )
+    return devices
+
+
+def run_dns_check() -> str:
+    """Run the DNS verification script and return its combined output."""
+    if not DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT.exists():
+        return ""
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+        cwd=str(DNS_CHECK_SCRIPT.parent),
+    )
+    return result.stdout + result.stderr
+
+
+def find_misconfigured_devices(output: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Return devices marked MISCONFIGURED by the DNS check."""
+    pattern = re.compile(
+        r"^(?P<name>.+?) \((?P<address>[^)]+)\) - MISCONFIGURED\s*$",
+        re.MULTILINE,
+    )
+    return [
+        {"name": match.group("name").strip(), "address": match.group("address").strip()}
+        for match in pattern.finditer(output)
+    ]
+
+
+def run_remote_command(server: dict[str, str], command: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
+    """Run a sudo command on a device and return exit code and output."""
+    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+    try:
+        client.connect(
+            hostname=server["address"],
+            username=server["username"],
+            password=server["password"],
+            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+            banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        )
+        stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
+            f"sudo -S -p '' sh -c {shlex.quote(command)}",
+            get_pty=True,
+            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        )
+        stdin.write(f"{server['password']}\n")
+        stdin.flush()
+        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        return stdout.channel.recv_exit_status(), output.strip(), error.strip()
+    finally:
+        client.close()
+
+
+def configure_dns(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
+    """Set both approved DNS servers in /etc/resolv.conf."""
+    command = (
+        f"printf '%s\\n' 'nameserver {DNS1}' 'nameserver {DNS2}' "
+        "'options timeout:2 attempts:2' > /etc/resolv.conf"
+    )
+    status, output, error = run_remote_command(server, command)
+    if output:
+        print(output)
+    if error:
+        print(f"Command errors: {error}")
+    return status == 0
+
+
+def verify_dns(server: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
+    """Verify that /etc/resolv.conf contains DNS1 and DNS2 only."""
+    status, output, error = run_remote_command(server, "cat /etc/resolv.conf")
+    servers = re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, re.MULTILINE)
+    correct = status == 0 and set(servers) == {DNS1, DNS2}
+    result = "SUCCESS" if correct else "FAILED"
+    print(f"{server['name']} ({server['address']}) - {result}")
+    print(f"  DNS servers: {servers or 'None'}")
+    if error:
+        print(f"  Verification errors: {error}")
+    return correct
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    devices = load_devices()
+    if not devices:
+        print("No eligible devices were found in network_devices.csv.")
+        return 0
+
+    print("Checking DNS settings on all eligible devices...")
+    check_output = run_dns_check()
+    misconfigured_devices = find_misconfigured_devices(check_output)
+    if not misconfigured_devices:
+        print("No devices are currently misconfigured; all DNS settings are already correct.")
+        return 0
+
+    print(f"Found {len(misconfigured_devices)} device(s) with incorrect DNS settings.")
+    configuration_results = []
+    verification_results = []
+
+    for device in misconfigured_devices:
+        print(f"\n{'=' * 60}\n{device['name']} ({device['address']})\n{'=' * 60}")
+        try:
+            target = next(item for item in devices if item["name"].lower() == device["name"].lower())
+            connected_and_configured = configure_dns(target)
+            if not connected_and_configured:
+                print("Unable to update DNS settings.")
+            configuration_results.append(connected_and_configured)
+            verification_results.append(verify_dns(target))
+            print(f"DEVICE SUCCESS: {device['name']} updated to DNS1 ({DNS1}) and DNS2 ({DNS2}).")
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print(f"Connection/configuration failed for {device['name']}: {exc}")
+            configuration_results.append(False)
+            verification_results.append(False)
+
+    print("\n===== DNS verification summary =====")
+    if verification_results and all(verification_results):
+        print("All devices have the correct internal DNS settings and report success.")
+        return 0
+
+    failed = sum(1 for result in verification_results if not result)
+    print(f"{failed} device(s) did not resolve to the expected DNS settings.")
+    return 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Connect to each device, fix incorrect DNS settings, and verify the internal DNS configuration."""
+
+import csv
+import re
+import shlex
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import paramiko
+
+
+CSV_FILE = Path(__file__).with_name("network_devices.csv")
+DNS1 = "10.10.10.10"
+DNS2 = "10.10.10.20"
+APPROVED_DNS = {DNS1, DNS2}
+USERNAME = "ubuntu"
+PASSWORD = "ubuntu"
+SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+
+
+def load_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Load eligible devices from the inventory CSV."""
+    devices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    with CSV_FILE.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as csv_file:
+        for row in csv.DictReader(csv_file):
+            name = (row.get("Device Name") or "").strip()
+            address = (row.get("Device Address") or "").strip()
+            if not address or address.lower() in {"dhcp", "none"}:
+                continue
+            lower_name = name.lower()
+            if lower_name.startswith("router") or lower_name.startswith("sw") or "switch" in lower_name or lower_name == "smtp":
+                continue
+            devices.append(
+                {
+                    "name": name,
+                    "address": address,
+                    "username": (row.get("Username") or USERNAME).strip() or USERNAME,
+                    "password": (row.get("Password") or PASSWORD).strip() or PASSWORD,
+                }
+            )
+    return devices
+
+
+def read_dns_settings(device: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Read nameserver entries from /etc/resolv.conf on the device."""
+    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+    try:
+        client.connect(
+            hostname=device["address"],
+            username=device["username"],
+            password=device["password"],
+            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+            banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        )
+        _, stdout, _ = client.exec_command(
+            "cat /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || resolvectl dns",
+            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        )
+        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        return re.findall(r"^\s*nameserver\s+(\S+)", output, re.MULTILINE)
+    except Exception:
+        return []
+    finally:
+        client.close()
+
+
+def set_internal_dns(device: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
+    """Write the internal DNS servers to the device's resolv.conf file."""
+    command = (
+        f"printf '%s\\n' 'nameserver {DNS1}' 'nameserver {DNS2}' "
+        "'options timeout:2 attempts:2' > /etc/resolv.conf"
+    )
+    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
+    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
+    try:
+        client.connect(
+            hostname=device["address"],
+            username=device["username"],
+            password=device["password"],
+            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+            banner_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+            auth_timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        )
+        stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(
+            f"sudo -S -p '' sh -c {shlex.quote(command)}",
+            get_pty=True,
+            timeout=SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        )
+        stdin.write(f"{device['password']}\n")
+        stdin.flush()
+        output = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        error = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        exit_code = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
+        if output.strip():
+            print(output.strip())
+        if error.strip():
+            print(error.strip())
+        return exit_code == 0
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(f"Failed to update DNS on {device['name']}: {exc}")
+        return False
+    finally:
+        client.close()
+
+
+def dns_is_reachable(dns_ip: str) -> bool:
+    """Check whether a DNS server is reachable via ping."""
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", dns_ip],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    return result.returncode == 0
+
+
+def verify_dns(device: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
+    """Verify the device points to the approved internal DNS servers and that they respond."""
+    servers = read_dns_settings(device)
+    reachable = all(dns_is_reachable(server) for server in servers) if servers else False
+    correct = set(servers) == APPROVED_DNS and reachable
+    return correct, servers
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Fix misconfigured DNS settings and print the result for each affected device."""
+    print("Connecting to devices with incorrect DNS settings...\n")
+
+    for device in load_devices():
+        current_dns = read_dns_settings(device)
+        if set(current_dns) == APPROVED_DNS:
+            success, final_dns = verify_dns(device)
+            final_status = "SUCCESS" if success else "FAILED"
+            print(f"Device name: {device['name']}")
+            print(f"IP address of DNS: {', '.join(final_dns) if final_dns else 'None'}")
+            print(f"Status: {final_status}")
+            print()
+            continue
+
+        print(f"Updating DNS on {device['name']} ({device['address']})")
+        changed = set_internal_dns(device)
+        if changed:
+            current_dns = read_dns_settings(device)
+        success, final_dns = verify_dns(device)
+        final_status = "SUCCESS" if success and changed else "FAILED"
+
+        print(f"Device name: {device['name']}")
+        print(f"IP address of DNS: {', '.join(final_dns) if final_dns else 'None'}")
+        print(f"Status: {final_status}")
+        print()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Email stakeholders after verifying that device DNS settings were resolved."""
+
+import smtplib
+import sys
+from email.message import EmailMessage
+
+from d4_verify_new_dns import load_devices, verify_dns
+
+
+SMTP_HOST = "smtp.d522.wgu.internal"
+SMTP_PORT = 1025
+FROM_ADDRESS = "network-monitoring@localdomain"
+TO_ADDRESS = "stakeholders@localdomain"
+SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+SUBJECT = "RESOLVED: DNS Service Issue and Device Compromise—All Issues Remediated"
+
+
+def get_resolved_devices() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Use d4_verify_new_dns.py's inventory and verification logic to generate the resolved device list."""
+    resolved_devices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    for device in load_devices():
+        try:
+            is_resolved, _ = verify_dns(device)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print(f"Could not verify {device['name']} ({device['address']}): {exc}")
+            continue
+
+        if is_resolved:
+            resolved_devices.append(device)
+    return resolved_devices
+
+
+def build_email(devices: list[dict[str, str]]) -> EmailMessage:
+    """Build one resolution email containing all successfully remediated devices."""
+    device_list = "\n".join(
+        f"- Hostname: {device['name']} | IP address: {device['address']}"
+        for device in devices
+    )
+    body = (
+        "Dear Stakeholders,\n\n"
+        "This is an automated notification to inform you that the DNS service issue and all related device compromises have been successfully resolved.\n\n"
+        "The following devices were affected and have now been remediated:\n\n"
+        f"{device_list}\n\n"
+        "No further action is required at this time. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the IT support team.\n\n"
+        "Thank you for your attention.\n\n"
+        "Best regards,\n"
+        "Network Monitoring System"
+    )
+    message = EmailMessage()
+    message["Subject"] = SUBJECT
+    message["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS
+    message["To"] = TO_ADDRESS
+    message.set_content(body)
+    return message
+
+
+def send_resolution_emails(devices: list[dict[str, str]]) -> bool:
+    """Send a resolution email for the resolved devices and verify the SMTP server accepted it."""
+    if not devices:
+        print("No devices with resolved DNS settings were found; no emails sent.")
+        return True
+
+    all_sent = True
+    try:
+        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as server:
+            server.ehlo()
+            print(f"Connected to email server {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT}")
+            message = build_email(devices)
+            refused = server.send_message(message)
+            accepted = not refused
+            status = "SUCCESS" if accepted else "FAILED"
+            print(
+                f"{status}: resolution email for {len(devices)} device(s) accepted by the email server"
+            )
+            all_sent = all_sent and accepted
+    except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
+        print(f"FAILED: could not connect to {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return False
+    return all_sent
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    devices = get_resolved_devices()
+    print(f"Found {len(devices)} device(s) with resolved DNS settings.")
+    return 0 if send_resolution_emails(devices) else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import time
+import requests
+
+GNS3_SERVER = "http://localhost:3080"
+PROJECT_ID = "980fb060-20d5-4268-8ba6-f215a2b4f9c3"
+
+SERVER_NODES = ["DNS1", "DNS2", "API", "DB", "SMTP", "SVR1", "SVR2"]
+ROUTER_NODE = "ROUTER1" # dhcp service
+SWITCH_NODES = ["SW1", "SW2", "SW3", "SW4"]
+DHCP_CLIENT_NODES = ["PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "WEBTERM"]
+
+DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START = 120  # seconds
+
+session = requests.Session()
+
+def get_nodes():
+    r = session.get(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes")
+    r.raise_for_status()
+    return r.json()
+
+def find_node_by_name(nodes, name):
+    for node in nodes:
+        if node["name"] == name:
+            return node
+    raise ValueError(f"Node not found: {name}")
+
+def start_node(node_id, node_name):
+    r = session.post(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes/{node_id}/start")
+    r.raise_for_status()
+    print(f"Started: {node_name}")
+
+def print_green(msg):
+    print(f"\033[92m{'\n' + msg}\033[0m")
+
+def main():
+    nodes = get_nodes()
+
+    print_green("Starting network switches...")
+    for name in SWITCH_NODES:
+        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
+        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
+
+    print_green("Starting server nodes...")
+    for name in SERVER_NODES:
+        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
+        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
+
+    print_green("Starting network router and dhcp...")
+    dhcp_node = find_node_by_name(nodes,ROUTER_NODE)
+    start_node(dhcp_node["node_id"], dhcp_node["name"])
+
+    interval = 5
+    remaining = DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START
+
+    print(f"Waiting {DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START} seconds for DHCP service to come up...")
+    while remaining > 0:
+        print(f"  ⏳ {remaining} seconds remaining...")
+        sleep_time = min(interval, remaining)
+        time.sleep(sleep_time)
+        remaining -= sleep_time
+
+    print("Done waiting for DHCP service.")
+
+    print_green("\nStarting DHCP clients...")
+    for name in DHCP_CLIENT_NODES:
+        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
+        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
+
+    print_green("GNS3 network startup complete.")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+
+SERVER_NODES = ["DNS1", "DNS2", "API", "DB", "SMTP", "SVR1", "SVR2"]
+ROUTER_NODE = "ROUTER1" # dhcp service
+SWITCH_NODES = ["SW1", "SW2", "SW3", "SW4"]
+DHCP_CLIENT_NODES = ["PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "WEBTERM"]
+
+DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START = 120  # seconds
+
+session = requests.Session()
+
+def get_nodes():
+    r = session.get(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes")
+    r.raise_for_status()
+    return r.json()
+
+def find_node_by_name(nodes, name):
+    for node in nodes:
+        if node["name"] == name:
+            return node
+    raise ValueError(f"Node not found: {name}")
+
+def start_node(node_id, node_name):
+    r = session.post(f"{GNS3_SERVER}/v2/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/nodes/{node_id}/start")
+    r.raise_for_status()
+    print(f"Started: {node_name}")
+
+def print_green(msg):
+    print(f"\033[92m{'\n' + msg}\033[0m")
+
+def main():
+    nodes = get_nodes()
+
+    print_green("Starting network switches...")
+    for name in SWITCH_NODES:
+        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
+        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
+
+    print_green("Starting server nodes...")
+    for name in SERVER_NODES:
+        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
+        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
+
+    print_green("Starting network router and dhcp...")
+    dhcp_node = find_node_by_name(nodes,ROUTER_NODE)
+    start_node(dhcp_node["node_id"], dhcp_node["name"])
+
+    interval = 5
+    remaining = DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START
+
+    print(f"Waiting {DELAY_AFTER_DHCP_START} seconds for DHCP service to come up...")
+    while remaining > 0:
+        print(f"  ⏳ {remaining} seconds remaining...")
+        sleep_time = min(interval, remaining)
+        time.sleep(sleep_time)
+        remaining -= sleep_time
+
+    print("Done waiting for DHCP service.")
+
+    print_green("\nStarting DHCP clients...")
+    for name in DHCP_CLIENT_NODES:
+        node = find_node_by_name(nodes, name)
+        start_node(node["node_id"], node["name"])
+
+    print_green("GNS3 network startup complete.")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
\ No newline at end of file
